What do 8 of the nation's top 10 cities for unemployment rate bounce back have in common? They are all in Arizona! | |
---
| | |
---
| | | Hello,

Recently, WalletHub released their study of which U.S. cities bounced back the most from the pandemic. They looked at 180 cites across the country and found that __**8 of the top 10 cities for recovery are right here in Arizona**__.

See where your city ranks on the list:

---
|
---
|
### Here are the 10 most recovered cities:
**1\. Scottsdale, AZ** **2\. Tempe, AZ** **3\. Gilbert, AZ** 4\. Burlington, VT **5\. Chandler, AZ** **6\. Mesa, AZ** **7\. Glendale, AZ** 8\. South Burlington, VT **9\. Peoria, AZ** **10\. Phoenix, AZ**

Peter,

Never believe the Left’s narrative that America is a racist country; that the American dream doesn’t exist anymore; or that the Constitution is a relic of the past that disproportionately benefits Anglo Americans.

I’m speaking with authority on the matter: **I’m a first generation Haitian-American whose parents came to this country, quite literally penniless, to pick crops in South Florida during the 1980s**. Now, less than forty years after my parents experienced food insecurity and homelessness, I’m running for Congress – as a Republican. **I guess you could say that I don’t fit the Left’s definition of a conservative**.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=95c4716fb49f4e2fb8d9e33f6ad6c0d1&_e=VcNnipa7d5CUS3VLRkTZhfjpmOK60nRdbzvJeAaEiP0OSHBD-mKE6eHh-_3iJIiBrvI7z0zYI1r-CnAICuJwNFiYb7oEvokzT1nRVNo1JAX_UtZ7Ox5fEGsCnteqdYtxLbSZ6zhU3c6gU7koquXOq1QXn29DfymUnbDs_l_hw-_9gXvJ4MFMTzELbSog865YxZq7JXDp6aio5IyFe_VeQJtcRLNQCaG8dFHUYcuRiLzmxTXHm2h8auzIRR1HR7BvK4Q2rIqKUjr3wHJAQDrHHonejXO16WlL0W-5AEIT0t_2ZfozOyQ4VNeqElJHvMGVrFQpu0ALu2H0I400_6US2DRVpWw1If1tqnbT-NszibiavwB6tWXdYlkwhExfA8BzaociKvfi8d0uMqmBcLIhkWdIoSsaEv3NO5HdNc33A4UL-xrVBQ9CTqVwnGBLxan7oVFulkIVqmbmxRK97d7CAO8qPLJA8Zo5_l6DnCShV6c%3D)
My name is Rod Dorilas and I’d like to tell you a few important things about me and why I’m writing to you today.
* I’m a military veteran (**I joined at 17**),
* I’m a lawyer (**I utilized the GI bill to pay for law school**)
* I’m a former Trump Administration appointee, having held various jobs during the four years President Trump held office.

**The thing I’m most proud about? My family built our own American Dream without the help of the government, or left-wing socialist politicians. And I’m running for Congress because some folks in DC just don’t understand that the government is not going to help make individuals successful – grit, determination and personal responsibility are keys to success.**

In his 1967 inaugural address as Governor of California, Ronald Reagan said, “ _**freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction**_.” Coming from an immigrant family, I believe it’s my responsibility to fight to make sure that people in this country know how precious freedom - and the United States - truly is.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=95c4716fb49f4e2fb8d9e33f6ad6c0d1&_e=VcNnipa7d5CUS3VLRkTZhfjpmOK60nRdbzvJeAaEiP0OSHBD-mKE6eHh-_3iJIiBrvI7z0zYI1r-CnAICuJwNFiYb7oEvokzT1nRVNo1JAX_UtZ7Ox5fEGsCnteqdYtxLbSZ6zhU3c6gU7koquXOq1QXn29DfymUnbDs_l_hw-_9gXvJ4MFMTzELbSog865YxZq7JXDp6aio5IyFe_VeQJtcRLNQCaG8dFHUYcuRiLzmxTXHm2h8auzIRR1HR7BvK4Q2rIqKUjr3wHJAQDrHHmpidYjEgl1hGjn7ShDWqZhstsgSjVy6Y3tH53WecjJ1uUCF5--HxYmi2xaA0qgrIyvtTRQgBiBRe15q9zfq7VGPu3AtCRWiiWX9xY9d1XteUNXafzKtd52fMY1F9U-WsPXzQAnz3y_93twoH2fBvldgdRxz4d99T2hnrgdk8NPs6xR4XQzUKELuJA79gVrSTl8kTZc4Cmtf1V5SV4qwsKY%3D)
I’m asking you to continue reading the rest of this email, but if you cannot, **[please consider chipping in whatever you can spare to my campaign today](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=95c4716fb49f4e2fb8d9e33f6ad6c0d1&_e=VcNnipa7d5CUS3VLRkTZhfjpmOK60nRdbzvJeAaEiP0OSHBD-mKE6eHh-_3iJIiBrvI7z0zYI1r-CnAICuJwNFiYb7oEvokzT1nRVNo1JAX_UtZ7Ox5fEGsCnteqdYtxLbSZ6zhU3c6gU7koquXOq1QXn29DfymUnbDs_l_hw-_9gXvJ4MFMTzELbSog865YxZq7JXDp6aio5IyFe_VeQJtcRLNQCaG8dFHUYcuRiLzmxTXHm2h8auzIRR1HR7BvK4Q2rIqKUjr3wHJAQDrHHicohXb0tAO0-6LNhREa1fWQGc_diekz5-9H13kF3lNgpectdHCGCspAjuTf8UPponuWuMpyU7f4jiwSrj0eWaJEYIjsPJ5KxCwHR9y3PN4HFxjAaaWvMK8al-BL-LVdtJFvjBfF0xNkJ2A6Fqqp1LCldPiDobnSeyTLSPiS_I43uhpTYijnXWlyLFvNRynbvdUUryjpShR4C8Oo2k737Po%3D)**. I’ve accomplished a lot in my short career, but I’m not independently wealthy and can’t fund my own campaign. I know I would be an effective voice for our party – I just need to make sure people in my district know who I am and what I stand for.

[** PLEASE SEND A DOLLAR OR TWO TODAY>>**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=95c4716fb49f4e2fb8d9e33f6ad6c0d1&_e=VcNnipa7d5CUS3VLRkTZhfjpmOK60nRdbzvJeAaEiP0OSHBD-mKE6eHh-_3iJIiBrvI7z0zYI1r-CnAICuJwNFiYb7oEvokzT1nRVNo1JAX_UtZ7Ox5fEGsCnteqdYtxLbSZ6zhU3c6gU7koquXOq1QXn29DfymUnbDs_l_hw-_9gXvJ4MFMTzELbSog865YxZq7JXDp6aio5IyFe_VeQJtcRLNQCaG8dFHUYcuRiLzmxTXHm2h8auzIRR1HR7BvK4Q2rIqKUjr3wHJAQDrHHlv2MvF-KBEcpc5h1gf261oqmpWs6X7Lz_kZQXkfSMQCsewrkfFlvm1YbuQ0DDpWwyxDe9t2gV-dTcvj1UGv8r0FVwhQ-c41O1y7CfbBInxChuMK--3VSEoeZBxk4_vcfH6ICLg5AqoRaqlGzjttyYDqrisl_EcvsFD6kysh1IgQn1nw_mj25ARkDysaCS5gUv7dQ4g7daMq-B8Q2LoYxrc%3D)
Every morning that I read the news, it’s more doom and gloom. No one talks about the American Dream anymore. But, my parents and I are living proof that it still exists – and will continue to exist for future generations of immigrants and native-born Americans alike if we wake up to the dangers posed by socialism NOW. That is going to take hard work on all of our parts.

| | | May 5, 2022 Hi Friends, October came in May this year.

Desperate for any excuse to turn the conversation from the Democrat’s failures at the border, the gas pump, the grocery store, the defunding of our police, national security, and so much more, some leftist stooge leaked the preliminary opinion from the SCOTUS decision on Roe v Wade. While we’ve learned to expect an “October surprise” from Democrats, America was caught off guard when this unprecedented political stunt dropped in early May.

The word “unprecedented” can scarcely describe the magnitude of what has happened here. While we’ve grown used to “oval office leaks” and even some “congressional leaks,” never before has a leak occurred from the once inviolate SCOTUS. But then, that’s part of the end-game of the left. The goal? To undermine every pillar of American government, faith, and the traditional family. They want us to be worker bees while the government manages every area of our lives—from working to wages, from restrooms to reproduction.

Today’s leftists wallow in a dark mindset of self-hatred and they are determined to drag the rest of us into their nihilistic vision for America, where life has no meaning and children are seen as burdens, not blessings.

Friends, I have a different worldview. I believe that life is precious and should be celebrated and protected. l believe that we were created in God’s image and that each person has a divine purpose—both the born and the unborn. Our Founding Fathers believed this too, and they declared boldly that we all have the basic right ... to life. Liberty and the pursuit of happiness don’t mean much if you’re denied the right to life.

If you share that belief, I need your help to get to Congress. We don’t need any more RINOs who consistently side with the party of darkness. Our nation needs a voice of hope and life—and we are at a moment in time where we can make sure it happens.

In the months leading up to the midterms, we should expect to see more riots, more lawlessness, and more messages of doom and gloom for America. I see a brighter future, where we lift people up and shine the bright light of freedom for all Americans, born and unborn. For Freedom,

# Biden puts illegal immigrants before our veterans
**By Wesley Hunt | May 5th**
America’s sovereignty is under attack and so are the brave men and women who served our country. The U.S. - Mexico Border is facing an overwhelming surge in illegal crossings, where in roughly 18 months, more than three million immigrants have illegally entered the United States. Now, the Biden Administration wants to divert resources away from the Department of Veterans Affairs to care for the very same illegals that have poured into our country.
Last week, during testimony before the House Appropriations Committee, Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas confirmed that DHS is considering a move to divert tax payer funded health care providers from the VA [to care for illegal immigrants](http://links.wesleyfortexas.com/u/click?_t=fd5d6e7aa0334e7ebb096a39dc496016&_m=4260ae9af3234c42a4ae9ae12ebafafa&_e=9uHzk_47faCppEjCnpaTrahNPtCi_pmkYuH__nwrjsrkTyGOUNfHfhm6X5T5OrBbvm_kv5QGakCtJ8wa_AY5NjH5jdfUTg354BKZ7yu_K1sRMmbE7n7mTNE8QYupgv7NXYat_X8YjvZnqz1y7gdUvGLsFfqSSBORFdeMbWlGozrIK98-U59cI3-8DKAHiZdkMUt7KYW0sU732-yr4waM_5oI3dj4QtauWk-E_Nzf5VfHrYRylC4b7DLFt9buvvuJ31MxGDNzia9wJ3JG6u7RfrDCmIg11RZZwkvxxMr1WGKdRwld-BFtT4A1cIYuXp0RInpRWr67mxjxBwVxB1v3_sQV0-QxORsARjg7GfJ7MuE%3D) along our southern border.
With its disastrous open-border policies, the Biden Administration has made clear that cartels, smugglers, and illegal migrants are welcome to break our laws and sneak into our country. To further aid these criminal groups, Joe Biden and his radical allies in Congress are prepared to take resources from our veterans and redistribute them to those migrants.
The priorities of the Biden Administration are a shocking rebuke of America’s veterans. Diverting VA staff aimed at helping veterans to illegal migrants at our southern border is a slap in the face to our nation’s finest. As an Army Combat Veteran and West Point Graduate, I had the honor of serving with 14 classmates who lost their lives in the global war on terror, with 4 more lives lost to suicide since I left the Army.
Even our troops who come home with minimal physical damage can still suffer from the mental trauma brought on by serving in a warzone.

| | | | Hey team,

First, thank you so much for all of your support. We are gaining so much momentum it's palpable. It has been such an honor to walk this out with you. This campaign is not about me. It's not about a title to achieve or a political career ladder to climb. This campaign is about us, We the People of the 2nd District of Virginia, taking our voices back to our government.

We are really kicking our campaign into a higher gear over the next 45 days. Early voting starts May 6th and the primary voting date is June 21st. I know that many of you have expressed interest in helping out. I wanted to personally write this email to inform you of our most needed areas for volunteering.

1\. Our greatest need is door knocking. We know that this is the surest way to secure a vote. Knock on a door, have a 2-5 minute conversation with someone and then ask if we can count on their vote. It really is that simple. Door knocking in a primary is an easy ask as we are simply talking with our fellow republicans. We go daily. We are making a big push this Saturday in Chesapeake and Virginia Beach. I would really appreciate for all of you to come out who can. I can promise you this is what will make the difference.

2\. Our second area we need help is for those of you who aren't able to walk and knock on doors or don't feel comfortable. We need people who will make calls and inform people about the primary and ask if we can count on their votes. This can be done from the comfort of your own home.

3\. Third, we need help staffing the voting polls for early voting, which starts May 6th. Each city is slightly different in their approach to doing this but the general idea is being outside of the polling locations to hand out a card with information about us and then say we hope we can count on their vote. We've found that people appreciate being asked for their vote. It shows we care enough about them to do so.

4\. Fourth, we really want to do more Meet and Greets. I have enjoyed having the opportunity to speak with people about the issues we all care about. If you would like to help set these up then please let us know. We've done them at people's homes, restaurants, community pool houses and private venues. I would like for us to keep doing 2-3 a week until the primary. I want to personally meet as many of our family, friends and neighbors as I possibly can. I believe it's critical that someone who is asking to represent people make themselves available to answer questions from those they seek to represent.

5\. Lastly, we need everyone to spread the word. If we can all try to connect with 5 new people each week it will go a long way. Then ask them to do the same. Word of mouth is the best way to keep growing a movement like ours.

Please email me at Tommy@tommy4va.com and let me know which of these areas you would be willing to help us with. Again, thank you so much. You humble me with your support and trust. Together we will take back our district and take back our country.

Yours in Freedom,

Tommy Altman
Republican Congressional Candidate
2nd District of Virginia
Tommy@tommy4va.com
757-771-6535

Bad Brad is a danger to the voters, and we need to defeat him before he can tip the outcome of future elections. He's not a kingmaker and that's why I need your help to remind him that we live in a country where the people will determine their elected representatives, not RINOs to leftists in Washington. **[Please donate today.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60321309:J2qDAioNZ:m:1:3317145305:BCE6078688E5E657CB14C5397876D5FA:r "Please donate today.")** In Freedom, Jody Hice

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq**
**The Leak **
What could be more devastating than today's Indiana primaries? Answer: The news that the Supreme Court will overturn Roe v. Wade.

In an unprecedented leak of documents, the draft opinion revealed the Court will side with Mississippi this summer in Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization, allowing states to ban a woman's right to choose. It's unbelievable!

It was long speculated that the Court would strike the landmark 1973 decision, but it's still shocking that in 2022, the Court would roll back decades of progress and turn a blind eye to thousands of women who die each year from terminating their own pregnancies at home out of fear.
**What does this mean? **
For now, nothing officially changes. A leaked document does not constitute a final ruling. However, in about two months, we will know for sure if the draft opinion was a sign of what was to come.
**What is a draft opinion? **
A draft opinion typically takes place after oral arguments cease. There's a conference among justices where they talk and take a vote. Then comes the drafting of the opinion. This process can take several weeks to months and justices can change their minds as the draft circulates. In this case, someone got their hands on the draft and gave it to a reporter.
**What happens next? **
While many conservatives may be celebrating this news, women across the country are pulling out their maps to see how far a more liberal-leaning state is from them. But the women suffering the most are the poorest among us who lack choices and resources. Statistically, poor women are subjected to more abuse and other forms of sexual crime and mistreatment than any other group.
**The Truth**
Now, here's the truth. This leaked draft opinion by the Court to strip women of their right to a safe, sound, and legal abortion foreshadows a dangerous attempt by a shrinking party to strip the American people of so much more!

The Indiana Democrats have more reason to fight now than ever before, but they haven't won a statewide race since 2012. A decade is more than enough time for contemplation. It's time we start winning again.

When we're on the same side as more than half the country when it comes to reproductive rights and so many other issues, how can we still lose? It's time we renew our efforts, mobilize on a unified front, put off laziness, and for goodness' sake, shred ourselves of naysayers who continue to jeopardize our potential to lead this great state.

Our friends across the aisle have taken a dangerous path. They have chosen to fight tooth and nail against fundamental freedoms that every American should have. As they look toward Hungary as their new example of what democracy should look like, we must keep our eyes on the Statue of Liberty and be unafraid to point them in that same direction!
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform them that I meant what I said in the beginning of my campaign when I said I would run for the Senate until **_we_** won!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=a671a11d3e&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=f59502fdef&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=f123bce6e3&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate
2022

Hello
Friend,
Have you
ever caught yourself wondering what heaven will be like? Of
course you have.
As
Christians, we know someday we will leave this world and be
united with God in heaven, yet many of us know very little about
this place.
The
overwhelming responsibilities of this world - and there are many
- often eclipse our thoughts about the next one. Heaven seems
remote and irrelevant to our existence.
Yet we
all yearn for a better world, especially when we experience
disappointments: a bad report from the doctor, the betrayal of a
friend, the breakup of an intimate relationship, financial
hardship, or the death of a loved one. At those times we want to
believe - we have to believe - that there is a better place.
Over and
over in the Bible, God promises you that there is a better place
... that His people will live with Him forever in a place where
perfect righteousness dwells. Heaven is a real place.

want to help elevate your thinking from earthbound concerns to

[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfr8c13m6huf9pi8qc92oe04ibpv618f0p80n1t8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sr4csr70pr4eerj2d776dhj5dr4slpnaob1eljjaspieqpm4db2e5rm4p5mcaoefkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p32phmcapm1ptimdj33c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)

---
Fellow American, It’s Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13_ and _The Green Mile_ — but the role that changed my life, and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, was as Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump_. **This year, I’m honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Fellow American, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvt9m47bt876vdcoequatj08nib8k543bcenpmhg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z50nepr7la1gebbqehl4cls5929jrjf9ft6pgkio_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs)
---
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6kmi9d927a3qtafo8actaitsq7v214800k5nsjg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs)
---
When the American Veterans Center first called me more than 15 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. Now, in 2022, they’re bringing the Parade back to its full-scale glory after two years of pandemic precautions. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our “Greatest Generation” heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country — the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ — as this year’s event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation’s heroes deserve.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdf47fgbt63fekiqe3t3piegd4n4oc5p1li57m9g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zne2j40cbvhacfk1qru0csp9qnado2avbgbpe240_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs)
---
The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that’s contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.
* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.
* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

---
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo5n9h4a5iuudjq7o6k23uv7vgsir2cv3iqtjo7o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs)
---
[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk1sgge747n3li7fv2vulpuj7lulrcgq4arce380_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs) But no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you.

On Memorial Day — this year and every year — please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in D.C. Visit a local veterans’ cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, but we can always do a little more._ Fellow American, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please — [**if you're able, make a gift to help fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z31k0l2ujgcrdlk6161mnil8857hnbpkp1as50hg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs)
---
Sincerely,

Gary Sinise
Honorary Grand Marshal
National Memorial Day Parade
---
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjsdq7fcpncfsq6nukrmo6negocdtt07e6n0i4lo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3j68oj6clh2bs)

And in 2022, this is going to be the state where Democrats lose their stranglehold on Black Americans. From helping Herschel Walker ascend to the Senate to stopping Leftist Stacey Abrams from winning the Governor's race, we have an action plan that will break the chains the Democrats have over Black voters and show them that the GOP is the true party of equality and prosperity. "Help us expose the racism of the Democrat masters to the Georgia Black voters with your donation of $25, $50, or $100 today." My name is James Golden, but you may know me as Mr. Snerdley, former call screener and producer for the late great radio legend Rush Limbaugh. I worked for Rush for almost 30 years, and I learned a lot sitting beside a great man like him every day. "Endorsed"I helped form New Journey PAC to show Black Americans the truth about the Democrat Party. For years, Democrats and their Leftist media allies have indoctrinated Black voters to think the GOP is racist and the Democrat Party is their only ally. And our efforts are working! We are seeing more and more Black Americans ditch their Democrat masters and vote for the Party of Lincoln. Georgia has the chance to be the tipping point to turn the steady stream of Black Americans turning to the GOP into a massive flood of new voters - but only if we have the resources to fully implement our Georgia turnout program. "That’s why I’m asking for your help. Can you chip in $100, $250, or $500 to help us get Black Voters to vote Republican in Georgia?" I mean it when I say Georgia is going to be front and center in 2022. We're going to have a Senate race where both the Democrat and Republican are going to be black candidates and we need to keep Herschel Walker leading in the polls until he wins the race in November. What better way to get Black voters engaged... especially when race no longer is a determining back. I know shocking... they're going to be judged on the content of their character! And then add the hot mess that Stacey Abrams brings to the Governor race... you can see why we must go ALL IN to engage Black Georgia voters and show them that the GOP is the TRUE party of equality. That's why I need you to dig deep. Georgia is the lynchpin to any hope of a Red Wave this November. But we got to start now if we have any chance to bring Georgia to the red column. "Just think about the collapse inside the Democrat Party when they lose their grip on Black Americans. What’s that worth to you to see that happen? $100? $500? Or even $1,000?" Whatever amount you can give, send it immediately. Georgia is too big a prize to lose and we have a chance to send the Democrats packing... "but only if you donate today." name: American Update
subject: A bright light during dark hours
body:
Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9936%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=gRGhibXS%2b3YRdx%2bPd4ISUQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20487%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2fvS86Z7oFD1BYBneA2GeLQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--like our free online courses. _ _ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author--C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20488%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I3uRb%2fqd1Ghi0APvziLLNw&sysid=1)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20489%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BPA%2b4zVXWjS72CfZdzPoNQ&sysid=1),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20480%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8dE7vONqaiNKkVHKXmOdvw&sysid=1) We’ve also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20489%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BPA%2b4zVXWjS72CfZdzPoNQ&sysid=1)”** on DVD today. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/be-the-first-to-get-hillsdales-new-c-s-lewis-dvd-set/**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20481%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QuGQbTPt9VRvATWrgeCblw&sysid=1) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

subject: “Any old Black person will do.”

body:
While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece. | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60324245:J1-hVioN0:m:1:3317145305:E2DF8DA747DE226B8D15750FD854C314:r)

---
Peter,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

"Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives."
Or maybe this line:

"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."
It's shameful.

But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too:

"Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it."
Peter, I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign. However, can you imagine the reaction from the mainstream media if these things had been said about a Black Democrat? The outrage! There would be calls for the writer to be fired and the publication cancelled.

But I'm not calling for a protest of the author or a boycott of the publication's advertisers. Nothing like that.

_**I think the best answer is to prove them wrong at the ballot box.**_

**[Will you join me in standing up to these racist attacks?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60324245:J1-hVioN0:m:1:3317145305:E2DF8DA747DE226B8D15750FD854C314:r)**

**[Stand with Herschel against far-left attacks](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60324245:J1-hVioN0:m:1:3317145305:E2DF8DA747DE226B8D15750FD854C314:r)**
[** Chip in $4 -> **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60324246:J1-hVioN0:m:1:3317145305:E2DF8DA747DE226B8D15750FD854C314:r)
The media has been against our campaign since we launched last summer, but they have rarely been so brazen to say things as this:

"Georgia Republicans want Walker because he's Black and Warnock is Black, and they think they can defeat Warnock in November if they can shave just a little of the Black vote..."
I'm not **" any old Black person"** as the author of the article asserts. I'm Herschel Walker - a proud Georgian and a proud Republican - who has lived the American Dream and wants to secure that dream for the next generation of Americans from all walks of life.

_The best way to deal with racist tropes like these are to call them out, reject them, and prove them wrong._

I hope you'll stand with me against the political hit jobs that the far-left media keep throwing our way. **[Please support my campaign for the U.S. Senate today, and let's work together to unite this country instead of dividing it.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60324245:J1-hVioN0:m:1:3317145305:E2DF8DA747DE226B8D15750FD854C314:r)**

Thank you,

Remember when there were 30 days left in this crucial race and we announced we were in a statistical tie for FIRST? Now there are 13 DAYS left in this CRUCIAL race and we're announcing that we're in a statistical tie for first AGAIN.

Against all odds, we've been doing great. We continue to hit our goals, and rise in the polls. Our opponents have deep pockets and polls don't win alone, though. If we don't have the resources to win this nomination, Pennsylvania will go Democrat and we will lose the senate. It's that simple. I truly believe this is the most important race in our country today.
We need to be everywhere we can be. Every day more and more people discover us and lend their support. That happens because of us having the resources to put our message out there. [View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zljlev70gmnoi7gfdcre65onkat835uona148ul0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3gm4o37cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf2tpge4ob6dlkehpn4sjmcqqm0s366hi38d32esqb8pr569ie4c9km9omcs5kmurt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor9cr4cup34phkcaqr9ptgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn7ihd935rrtctsf6f0svlj6bo3p26h6j7c2oleg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3gm4o37cjh2bs) Fellow Conservative, Every time I fill up my gas tank, I’m in shock.

_Just when you think gas prices can’t go any higher, they do!_

**This NEVER would have happened when I led the EPA as part of President Trump’s Cabinet. **

Anti-energy policies by Joe Biden are making America dependent again on our foes and harming hardworking American families with unreliable, unproven Green New Deal pipe dreams - _but I’m not about to sit by idly while they put shackles on American energy. _

**I’m running for the United States Senate in Oklahoma to BRING BACK President Trump’s energy boom and stand up for American citizens like YOU who are SICK AND TIRED of paying too much at the pump.**

[**Join me today to MAKE ENERGY AFFORDABLE AGAIN and get America’s energy sector BACK TO WORK!**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh451m6smi592bsbrvc73u84cfgrqboog378crro_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3gm4o37cjh2bs) [**MAKE ENERGY AFFORDABLE AGAIN**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp3fn5e5601cutop5b0bc8eocimjcmm0h1i04oa0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4c3gm4o37cjh2bs) Energy is something you shouldn’t have to think about, Fellow Conservative. America is blessed with an abundance of natural resources.

It’s _ridiculous_ that in Joe Biden’s America you can’t pay your bills or fill up your tank without wondering how you can afford everything else in your life.

body:
Excellent Candidate forum and debate last night
| | | | | Endorsement | April 22, 2022
---
|
---
| Erik wins Congressional Candidate Debate!
---
| | |
---|---
|
Tonight, Republican candidate for Congress Erik Aadland, a two-time Bronze Star--one for valor--earning combat veteran and former energy sector executive running in District 7, attended and won a CD7 Congressional debate bringing in a landslide 62.5% of the votes at the American Legion in Fairplay.
|
---
| "I love these debates because it clearly portrays each candidates' strengths and weaknesses. Tonight, I was able to highlight my global entrepreneurial experience, leadership qualities and passion for my state and country. I am thankful for this victory and know it will not be the last."
---
|
---
| Erik Aadland will be attending another Congressional District 7 (CD7) debate on Monday, May 9, at Platte Canyon High School in Bailey. The fun begins at 6:00PM - Don't miss it!
---
| |
---
| | [Send Erik your Feedback](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YQFM5ELfPkR3Ti-N4nfDowHAgT-jaMGl-y-dhJGiGmpZv39mV03C6VUDrollR3ak7dP09MDjhlbTI9bokNzzFyNQ3UnUhcCEGmFaWp_uSlRMlw-O36KlsYKQDtLZTKt8oW_ZByAz8DSBSMgNWLrHEHHTXwG2Tn_kOcB7-z1bdEfpu1xp_FDpOZ8mKfbz7kwKtkyZiMt7QXDTqJbvVI1mkCVi5r1KvL6f3Oys48BkhxWrbY6d7nqFlhuX0IX3FFNo&c=JnuEls3zYQ1m-kFplyCNHyXhPqSrSQBZexSWT3OJsdtpN9zOyXmjTw==&ch=M4_zcjLsV37fvJpjkMy346MB83HoJnMgTMNvawZxBfWeBMSKdIahwQ==)
---
| |
---
| About Erik Aadland
---
Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
| About Aadland For Congress:
---
Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign.
There is no family fortune behind this drive. No generations of beer barons, or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization.
Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in June of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people and neighbors.
If you are interested in an Area Coordinator opportunity with Erik's campaign, use the link below to send your information, or contact:

body:
By the time you read this, Liz Cheney will have finished one of the most exclusive and expensive fundraisers in the entire country – all so she can fatten her campaign war chest to stay in power. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6972%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=hSQp5RA7zyL7j%2bcEZ%2f8LCQ&sysid=1)
Friend, By the time you read this, Liz Cheney will have finished one of the most exclusive and expensive fundraisers in the entire country - _all so she can fatten her campaign war chest to stay in power._ Worse yet - she's teamed up with the same elitist Never-Trumpers who've put fealty to Big Government over _We the People_ and the people of Wyoming: [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61738%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fCkZedr78oT5ogJ%2fbgDuHA&sysid=1) Once again, friend, Liz Cheney could be spending her time fighting for you against Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi's arrogant authoritarianism. But instead, she's wasting it at fancy cocktail parties with Mitt Romney, John Boehner, and the NeoCons who long ago sold out our country . . . And are clamoring for War with Russia! Is it any wonder? These career politicians are more beholden to CNN anchors than to you and me, and they'll do _anything_ to keep power. That's not me, friend. As you know, I've spent my entire life fighting for Wyomingites against Big Government overreach, and unlike Liz Cheney, I'll actually fight for Americans like you in Congress. But first, I'll need your help to get there. [**So I must ask, friend: Will you show your support for my America First campaign to defeat Liz Cheney with an $35 donation BEFORE the end of quarter fundraising deadline?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61739%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vo3Q5t3S%2fGeU%2b2Ckb%2fpG9w&sysid=1) I truly hope the answer is **YES**. And am asking you to use it to rush your donation to my campaign in the next 24 hours because we are scraping up against one of this year's most important filing deadlines. You should know we have our work cut out for us. Even before she turned to one of _**Jeb Bush's**_ top supporters to throw her recent fundraiser, Cheney reported a record-braking haul last year - and currently sits on $4.72 million dollars of elitist, Never-Trumper cash! It's not hard to see how she got it - after all, at her recent fundraiser with Mitt Romney, she charged "VIPs" over $10,000 just to attend! But what's truly scary? _**Liz Cheney raised that money by calling conservatives like you "crazies" and a "threat" to our Democracy, repeating the same old LIES that Democrats and the Media have spread.**_ I'm not going to let her get away with it, and I hope you won't either. So please, would you consider making a generous donation to my campaign to defeat her? Now, friend, I'm not tone deaf enough to ask my supporters for $10,000 amidst Joe Biden's self-induced inflation nightmare. I know real Americans are hurting, and that every dollar I receive from patriots like you is a blessing. **[So, if you can't quite afford to make a $35 donation to my campaign, I hope you'll make the very best donation you can.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61730%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4M6jsJ1iB%2fO7ANtm7wY3kg&sysid=1)** Because while polls show Cheney is in trouble, she can still buy her way out of it - especially if Democrat donors continue to help her. So, know that if you're able to make a large donation of $1,000 or more, that will certainly bolster my campaign as we take our message to all 98 thousand square miles of Wyoming! But, whether you can give just a few dollars for small expenses, or $1,000 dollars to help with larger expenses like TV ads, the important point is that you rush back your donation within the next 24 hours. After all, Cheney's establishment backers are powerful, and the closer we get to the election, the more we can expect career politicians like Mitt Romney to try to bail her out. Your donation, and your continued support, helps me fight back. And it helps me keep momentum in this must win race for our America First Conservative movement. And in case I haven't said it enough, friend: _Thank You._ I couldn't have made it this far without you. Your support -- especially your financial support -- is a tremendous blessing. And it will help us defeat Liz Cheney and put _We the People_ before Big Government. Respectfully, [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61731%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SkMYVmVbfRXdM44SPT4C7w&sysid=1) Harriet Hageman America First Conservative for Congress (WY) [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61731%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SkMYVmVbfRXdM44SPT4C7w&sysid=1) P.S. Liz Cheney continues to raise millions of dollars off glitzy fundraisers held with establishment politicians, and now that she's bringing Mitt Romney in to help her campaign, I need you to show them that our America First movement is strong and rejects their anti-Trump rhetoric and constant overtures to the Left. **[My campaign to defeat Cheney has momentum, but we can't keep it without your support. So please, would you send a generous gift of $35 in the next 24 hours?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61732%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DJ8z%2b%2byd2b10b4%2bq6AfMNg&sysid=1)** [ **DONATE** ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61733%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=W2OCcZeXGQNU%2f5s8S%2bCd9Q&sysid=1) **PAID FOR BY HAGEMAN FOR WYOMING** [Privacy Policy](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c61734%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=pZST1Q1wEchtCisxNqcMeA&sysid=1) | 2020 All Rights Reserved | info@HagemanforWyoming.com P.O. Peter, **That's right.****Early voting in our Republican Primary for Virginia's 7th Congressional District begins tomorrow.** If you haven't already, _now_ is the time to make a plan to vote!
---
[**CLICK HERE TO FIND YOUR EARLY VOTING LOCATION**](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/9b1e8d0d111966e1/3db1c5582045aaf0c3d6b838967d376c/40203)
---
First things first: **Are you registered to vote?** The voter registration period for our Republican Primary is open through May 31st, and you can [**click here to check the status of your voter registration**](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/9b1e8d0d111966e1/6cd995b6cf66fd37c3d6b838967d376c/40203). **If your registration is all set, you're ready to cast your ballot!** For that there are a few options: **In-person voting:** You can vote in person on Primary Day (June 21st), __but you can also cast your ballot in-person beginning tomorrow morning at your local voter registrar's office__. The early voting period lasts from tomorrow, May 6th through Saturday, June 18th. [Click here to find your early voting location.](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/9b1e8d0d111966e1/57c33a4dbcab5967c3d6b838967d376c/40203) **Vote by mail:** In Virginia, voters can request an absentee, mail-in ballot with no required excuse, so long as the ballot request is **_received_** by your local voter registrar by **5:00pm on Friday, June 10th**. [Click here for more information about requesting your absentee mail-in ballot and how to to submit it!](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/9b1e8d0d111966e1/c6176a0446c28167c3d6b838967d376c/40203) Once you receive your ballot in the mail, you may return your completed ballot to your general registrar’s office by mail or personally deliver it to your general registrar. If returned by mail, your ballot will be counted if it is postmarked by **Primary Election Day on June 21st** and received by your local registrar by **Noon on Friday, June 24th**. **That's it!** Once you've submitted your ballot in person or by mail, you can [track it any time by going online to the Virginia Department of Elections website.](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/9b1e8d0d111966e1/135a9e5e80f6c751c3d6b838967d376c/40203) If you're on social media - be sure to post a picture and tag us [@VoteVanuch on Twitter](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/9b1e8d0d111966e1/1429a6f3bf5e0b60c3d6b838967d376c/40203) or [VoteVanuch on Facebook](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/5815412c19d967813a89ac0c84d83476/40203/9b1e8d0d111966e1/4cf26855bef287cfc3d6b838967d376c/40203)! **THANK YOU for your continued support of my campaign!** As your Congresswoman, I will fight for Virginia families, stop the Biden-Pelosi-Spanberger liberal agenda, and support commonsense policies that help all Virginians. Please forward this email and spread the word to your likeminded friends, family, and neighbors. We need proven conservative leadership that understands the needs of our community. Leadership you can _**_trust_**_. God bless,

That girl is me, friend.
I grew up the daughter of a maid and a janitor, living with my six siblings in a two-bedroom, A-framed home in Jacksonville. With a lot of hard work, I became the first in my family to graduate college – and then, I entered the police academy at a time when there were hardly any Black women working as officers.
People told me I didn't belong in the force, but I risked my life to protect my community, working the night shifts as a beat cop. Years later, I became the first woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.
I'm no stranger to adversity, friend. That's why it doesn't faze me when people like the chair of the Republican National Committee attack me personally, or when the GOP launches desperate attack ads to defeat me. **I always keep my eye on the prize, but the truth is I know I can't win this race alone. So I need your help right now to make sure Floridians aren't swayed by these lies, friend.**

body:
Peter, By the time you read this, Liz Cheney will have finished one of the most exclusive and expensive fundraisers in the entire country - _all so she can fatten her campaign war chest to stay in power._ Worse yet - she's teamed up with the same elitist Never-Trumpers who've put fealty to Big Government over _We the People_ and the people of Wyoming: [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325577:J06kKiorN:m:1:3317145305:C4C34393F7ACDAF70A12E5D2B82F9952:r) Once again, Peter, Liz Cheney could be spending her time fighting for you against Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi's arrogant authoritarianism. But instead, she's wasting it at fancy cocktail parties with Mitt Romney, John Boehner, and the NeoCons who long ago sold out our country . . . And are clamoring for War with Russia! Is it any wonder? These career politicians are more beholden to CNN anchors than to you and me, and they'll do _anything_ to keep power. That's not me, Peter. As you know, I've spent my entire life fighting for Wyomingites against Big Government overreach, and unlike Liz Cheney, I'll actually fight for Americans like you in Congress. But first, I'll need your help to get there. [**So I must ask, Peter: Will you show your support for my America First campaign to defeat Liz Cheney with an $35 donation BEFORE the end of quarter fundraising deadline?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325577:J06kKiorN:m:1:3317145305:C4C34393F7ACDAF70A12E5D2B82F9952:r) I truly hope the answer is **YES**. And am asking you to use it to rush your donation to my campaign in the next 24 hours because we are scraping up against one of this year's most important filing deadlines. You should know we have our work cut out for us. Even before she turned to one of _**Jeb Bush's**_ top supporters to throw her recent fundraiser, Cheney reported a record-braking haul last year - and currently sits on $4.72 million dollars of elitist, Never-Trumper cash! It's not hard to see how she got it - after all, at her recent fundraiser with Mitt Romney, she charged "VIPs" over $10,000 just to attend! But what's truly scary? _**Liz Cheney raised that money by calling conservatives like you "crazies" and a "threat" to our Democracy, repeating the same old LIES that Democrats and the Media have spread.**_ I'm not going to let her get away with it, and I hope you won't either. So please, would you consider making a generous donation to my campaign to defeat her? Now, Peter, I'm not tone deaf enough to ask my supporters for $10,000 amidst Joe Biden's self-induced inflation nightmare. I know real Americans are hurting, and that every dollar I receive from patriots like you is a blessing. **[So, if you can't quite afford to make a $35 donation to my campaign, I hope you'll make the very best donation you can.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325577:J06kKiorN:m:1:3317145305:C4C34393F7ACDAF70A12E5D2B82F9952:r)** Because while polls show Cheney is in trouble, she can still buy her way out of it - especially if Democrat donors continue to help her. So, know that if you're able to make a large donation of $1,000 or more, that will certainly bolster my campaign as we take our message to all 98 thousand square miles of Wyoming! But, whether you can give just a few dollars for small expenses, or $1,000 dollars to help with larger expenses like TV ads, the important point is that you rush back your donation within the next 24 hours. After all, Cheney's establishment backers are powerful, and the closer we get to the election, the more we can expect career politicians like Mitt Romney to try to bail her out. Your donation, and your continued support, helps me fight back. And it helps me keep momentum in this must win race for our America First Conservative movement. And in case I haven't said it enough, Peter: _Thank You._ I couldn't have made it this far without you. Your support -- especially your financial support -- is a tremendous blessing. And it will help us defeat Liz Cheney and put _We the People_ before Big Government. Respectfully, [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325577:J06kKiorN:m:1:3317145305:C4C34393F7ACDAF70A12E5D2B82F9952:r) Harriet Hageman America First Conservative for Congress (WY) [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325577:J06kKiorN:m:1:3317145305:C4C34393F7ACDAF70A12E5D2B82F9952:r) P.S. Liz Cheney continues to raise millions of dollars off glitzy fundraisers held with establishment politicians, and now that she's bringing Mitt Romney in to help her campaign, I need you to show them that our America First movement is strong and rejects their anti-Trump rhetoric and constant overtures to the Left. **[My campaign to defeat Cheney has momentum, but we can't keep it without your support. So please, would you send a generous gift of $35 in the next 24 hours?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325577:J06kKiorN:m:1:3317145305:C4C34393F7ACDAF70A12E5D2B82F9952:r)** [ **DONATE** ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325577:J06kKiorN:m:1:3317145305:C4C34393F7ACDAF70A12E5D2B82F9952:r) **PAID FOR BY HAGEMAN FOR WYOMING** [Privacy Policy](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325578:J06kKiorN:m:1:3317145305:C4C34393F7ACDAF70A12E5D2B82F9952:r) | 2020 All Rights Reserved | info@HagemanforWyoming.com P.O. name: Peter Franchot
subject: Major Construction Worker Union Endorsement!
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I’m deeply excited to announce that I’ve been endorsed by ALL of the LiUNA Mid-Atlantic District Councils and Local Unions. LiUNA is a major union representing thousands of construction workers in Maryland and nearly 40,000 within our region. Last year, I proudly received the backing of LiUNA Mid-Atlantic, and it’s an honor to receive the support of even more of our union brothers and sisters.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/liunalocalsendorsement?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/liunalocalsendorsement?amount=20.22]
For many years, I’ve been a staunch advocate of Project Labor Agreements (PLAs), which provide union workers with fair wages and conditions, and ensure that projects are completed on time and on budget. As Governor, I’ll pair a bold expansion of Maryland’s public works with a commitment to robust PLAs on every project. I’m going to make critical investments in major 21st century infrastructure projects like world-class transit, renewable energy, and statewide 5G to create 100,000 new family-supporting jobs for our workers. body:
I look forward to hearing from you directly.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44997910/344010333/-1740198439?amount=25&refcode=ea.be597d3a-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.be597d3a-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTU5N2QzYS00ZGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2nY0y7JZ_EOXWY0Vg4FZYmpGKfbr7L2hJ8w1SdSiYSY=) Peter, I am running for Congress because I deeply believe that the government can and should improve our lives. I know that good leadership can make this country a better place for all of us. My own life experiences inform what priorities I’ll seek to address in Washington.

**[I’d like to share a few of the issues that are the most important to me. First, will you let me know what matters most to you?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44997912/344010335/-946247555?refcode=ea.be597d3a-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.be597d3a-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTU5N2QzYS00ZGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2nY0y7JZ_EOXWY0Vg4FZYmpGKfbr7L2hJ8w1SdSiYSY=&emci=de3caa18-bfcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=be597d3a-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5944225)** | ****[TAKE MY SPRING ISSUES SURVEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44997914/344010338/-946247555?refcode=ea.be597d3a-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.be597d3a-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZTU5N2QzYS00ZGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2nY0y7JZ_EOXWY0Vg4FZYmpGKfbr7L2hJ8w1SdSiYSY=&emci=de3caa18-bfcc-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=be597d3a-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=5944225)****
---
* * *
My Top Issues
**_Healthcare_**
When I was a child, my younger brother was diagnosed with Hodgkin’s Lymphoma. Because care wasn’t available in our small town, my father had to travel to Madison with him for treatment. We wished my brother could have been treated closer to home. I know firsthand just how critical quality, accessible healthcare is to families like mine. **With the leaked Supreme Court decision earlier this week, protecting healthcare access, especially reproductive rights, is even more critical.**

**_Education_**
Ensuring the next generation has the best possible education is what will keep America competitive on the global stage - and it is what we owe to our children. To facilitate that excellent education, we have to pay teachers what they’re worth and fully fund our public schools. My own mother was a teacher, and I know that they go above and beyond every single day to shape the next generation. **Our government must ensure that America’s public education system is among the best in the world.**

**_Defending Democracy_**
During my career in the military and in the CIA, I watched democracies abroad thrive or fail based on the will and determination of the people. Now, American democracy is under threat by members of one party who refuse to accept the outcome of elections they do not win. The people’s will can overcome GOP extremism. **We must do everything in our power to secure voting rights and prevent anti-democracy radicals (like my GOP opponent) from taking over power.**
* * *
Peter, in Congress, I’ll work hard to address these issues and more, but I want you to know that first and foremost I will be serving as _your_ voice in Washington. **We likely share some priorities, but it’s important to me to hear the needs of our community directly from you.**

clean_body: I look forward to hearing from you directly. | = Peter, I am running for Congress because I deeply believe that the government can and should improve our lives. I know that good leadership can make this country a better place for all of us. My own life experiences inform what priorities I’ll seek to address in Washington. | ** My Top Issues Healthcare When I was a child, my younger brother was diagnosed with Hodgkin’s Lymphoma. Because care wasn’t available in our small town, my father had to travel to Madison with him for treatment. We wished my brother could have been treated closer to home. I know firsthand just how critical quality, accessible healthcare is to families like mine. With the leaked Supreme Court decision earlier this week, protecting healthcare access, especially reproductive rights, is even more critical. Education Ensuring the next generation has the best possible education is what will keep America competitive on the global stage - and it is what we owe to our children. To facilitate that excellent education, we have to pay teachers what they’re worth and fully fund our public schools. My own mother was a teacher, and I know that they go above and beyond every single day to shape the next generation. Our government must ensure that America’s public education system is among the best in the world. Defending Democracy During my career in the military and in the CIA, I watched democracies abroad thrive or fail based on the will and determination of the people. Now, American democracy is under threat by members of one party who refuse to accept the outcome of elections they do not win. The people’s will can overcome GOP extremism. We must do everything in our power to secure voting rights and prevent anti-democracy radicals (like my GOP opponent) from taking over power. Peter, in Congress, I’ll work hard to address these issues and more, but I want you to know that first and foremost I will be serving as your voice in Washington. We likely share some priorities, but it’s important to me to hear the needs of our community directly from you. We’ve put together a Spring Issues Survey where you can share what you’re thinking about most right now, whether that’s inflation, national security, education access, or something else. | **With Roe v. Wade about to be overturned, we must fight to protect a woman’s right to choose.**

**[Add Your Name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44998078/344010695/2040405168?refcode=DK_EM_PT_1MO_20220506_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjI0MmQ4NC00ZGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xqeAIMboT4qbZaSDptwXrsSbw3ER2aD3UGfnAyTuM1g=&emci=d93f187e-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=72242d84-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=31479900)**
* * *

The news that the Supreme Court is poised to overturn Roe v. Wade is an outrageous attack on women’s health care and the law of the land for _nearly 50 years._

Women should have the right to make their own health care decisions. This news, along with the fact that state legislatures nationwide have passed laws to limit reproductive rights, is a direct attack on that. Even here in Michigan, our opponents are taking a firm anti-choice stance.

As many as 28 states—** _including Michigan!_** —could ban or restrict our reproductive rights in a post-Roe world. That should outrage us.

**Make no mistake, this decision isn’t motivated by anything but politics—and that fact sets a dangerous precedent on the Court that once made rulings on same-sex marriage, birth control access and other key issues.

[To take a stand, Dan is asking you to join us immediately by signing your name to our petition to stand with women here in Michigan and across the country. Sign on by midnight to have your voice heard.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44998079/344010696/2040405168?refcode=DK_EM_PT_1MO_20220506_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjI0MmQ4NC00ZGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xqeAIMboT4qbZaSDptwXrsSbw3ER2aD3UGfnAyTuM1g=&emci=d93f187e-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=72242d84-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=31479900)** **[SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44998080/344010697/2040405168?refcode=DK_EM_PT_1MO_20220506_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjI0MmQ4NC00ZGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xqeAIMboT4qbZaSDptwXrsSbw3ER2aD3UGfnAyTuM1g=&emci=d93f187e-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=72242d84-4dcd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=31479900)**
Dan will always stand up for a woman’s right to choose, because the truth is that making abortions illegal won’t stop them from happening. It just will make it more dangerous and particularly adversely affect women of color and low-income women.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE CONTACT: [info@tobyforcongress.com](mailto:info@tobyforcongress.com "info@tobyforcongress.com") **TOBY ANDERSON TO TAYFUN SELEN AND PAUL DEGROOT: WHAT ARE YOU HIDING FROM?**_Anderson Calls For At Least Two Debates_ New Jersey – Today, Toby Anderson, candidate for Congress in New Jersey’s 11th district, called on Tayfun Selen and Paul DeGroot to participate in at least two debates prior to the June 7th primary election. “It’s unconscionable to think that any candidate for office would refuse to face voters in an open and public debate, and simply begs the question – ‘what are you hiding?’'' said Anderson. “Republican voters deserve to hear the candidates’ stance on the issues, and make an informed decision as to which candidate is best prepared to take on Mikie Sherrill. I’m calling on Mr. Selen and Mr. DeGroot to come out of hiding and participate in a minimum of two debates before primary election day.” Toby Anderson has already agreed to participate in a candidate forum hosted by the League of Women Voters to take place on May 11, an invitation rejected by Tayfun Selen and Paul DeGroot.###

Friend,

On behalf of my friend Maggie Hassan, I am asking everyone reading this to do your utmost to reelect the Senator come November.
I’ve spent decades making films about pivotal moments in our country’s history. Our story is complicated, and paved with glory, conflict, and sometimes shame. But I still believe in the great American promise, and in working to ensure everyone in our nation has every opportunity to realize that promise.

I've lived in Walpole, New Hampshire, for more than 40 years. I've seen the Granite State undergo a lot of change over the decades, flipping from red to blue and back again. But after all this time, I believe that 2022 will be the most important year in the history of our state - and our republic.

This is an incredibly fraught moment in time. But there's no doubt in my mind that my friend Maggie is up to the task: Again and again, the citizens of New Hampshire have been able to turn to her for thoughtful, inspired, and impactful public service.

The question is, will we be able to keep Maggie's indispensable voice in the Senate come November? With the Senate split 50-50, and with Washington divided, I believe her reelection will be an uphill battle – but I also believe Maggie is the person we need to bridge the gulf between the two parties that is wider now than I have ever seen.

These actions don’t solve anything. More often, they create a whole new set of problems.

Leadership matters, and that means elections and their outcomes matter, too.
That’s why our work together is so important. Lizzie is working to deliver solutions that make a meaningful difference in Texans’ lives — like protecting access to reproductive health care and making all health care more affordable.
We’re working to reach voters and talk to them about the work Lizzie is doing, which is essential now that we have a new map where 70% of voters are new to the district. **May 6, 2022

202.738.9089**
---
| |
# Bill McSwain: A Vote for Doug Mastriano Is A Vote for Josh Shapiro

**West Chester, Pa.** \-- Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today responded to [news](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=5e2d816d7d&e=b1ec95759b) that Josh Shapiro is running a pro-Mastriano ad on TV stations across the Commonwealth.

Shapiro is running the ad because he wants Mastriano to win the Republican gubernatorial primary on May 17, so that he can face Mastriano in the general election. Shapiro wants to run against the most beatable candidate. Referencing [Mastriano's meltdown](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=f259a68743&e=b1ec95759b)***** in a recent interview, McSwain noted that Mastriano has a history of poor judgment and volatility that make him an ineffective advocate for conservatives – and an unelectable candidate for Governor. In short, Shapiro has chosen wisely.

As McSwain explained, if Pennsylvania Republicans nominate Mastriano, they will be handing Shapiro a free pass to walk into the Governor's office and implement the full slate of progressive priorities, including higher taxes, Critical Race Theory in schools, and late-term abortions on demand.
---
|
> _**"****By trying to help Doug Mastriano win the nomination, Josh Shapiro is positioning himself to face the weakest, most beatable candidate possible. He knows that he can't beat me in the fall, and his calculus is correct - Doug Mastriano has a history of betraying conservatives at every turn, including advocating for a COVID registry, voting for Act 77 and no-excuse mail-in ballots, approving Wolf’s spending increases, and proposing the highest income tax increase in Pennsylvania history. **_ _**If Republicans in Pennsylvania allow Mastriano to become the nominee, they will be handing Josh Shapiro a free pass to waltz into the Governor's office and implement the full slate of progressive priorities, including late-term abortions, Critical Race Theory in schools, higher taxes, permanent no-excuse mail-in ballots and a criminal justice system that coddles violent criminals. In essence, a vote for Mastriano is a vote for Josh Shapiro.
>
> We can stop Shapiro and win in November, but first we need to nominate a strong conservative outsider who will never back down in defense of conservative values. I am the only candidate who can beat Josh Shapiro, and I know that together we can put our state back on track."**_
---
|
---
| **_*Relevant portion of[linked interview](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=23bb3c8659&e=b1ec95759b) begins at 10:05_**
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=7b357eb2f8&e=b1ec95759b)

We deserve better.

Hey team,
As of Tuesday night, **we are officially in the general election fight against Mike DeWine.**
I don’t need to tell you how much is at stake in this election, folks – particularly this week, when draft copy from the Supreme Court revealed that the right to access safe, legal abortion is in more danger than ever before.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45004163/344035525/-774123682?refcode=nw_em_220506_1_t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMThlZDQ5Yi01YmNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JsO4h_ANxfVpqCGWnxymdWPLqBNC7a3sGy8iFTqhWS0=)
_\- The Columbus Dispatch, 5/2/22_
Mike DeWine openly brags about being the most anti-abortion governor in the country. We cannot leave the fate of Ohioans’ reproductive rights in his hands – but we have a tough fight ahead.
**[We know already that Mike DeWine and his allies will spend big to take me down this year – in 2018, he personally loaned his campaign $4 million. I need your support to fight back. Will you chip in $5 right now to kick off the general election?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45004164/344035526/-774123682?refcode=nw_em_220506_1_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMThlZDQ5Yi01YmNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JsO4h_ANxfVpqCGWnxymdWPLqBNC7a3sGy8iFTqhWS0=)**
It’s not just abortion access – at every step, Mike DeWine has proven that he’s determined to take our state backwards. Rather than prioritize keeping jobs here in Ohio, or funding our public education system, or protecting Ohioans from the ongoing pandemic, he’s chosen to bail out big corporations with taxpayer money.
**We deserve better.** And I know that we can _do_ better – we can tackle the tough issues, fight the hard fights, and ensure that our government is working for Ohioans again – not for the special interests.
**[To take on Mike DeWine, we need to hit the ground running and kick the general election off strong: Pitch in $5 to my campaign and help move Ohio forward this year>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45004165/344035527/-774123682?refcode=nw_em_220506_1_t2&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMThlZDQ5Yi01YmNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JsO4h_ANxfVpqCGWnxymdWPLqBNC7a3sGy8iFTqhWS0=)**
Onward,
Nan Whaley

| | | **ALERT: A new leak from the Supreme Court suggests Roe v. Wade will be overturned! The left is already responding radically to push their will on the people.___It's time to stand up now to protect our court and defend life._**
---
[**CHIP IN NOW >>**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c20414%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4V%2fXCwQdsYekD4f0Lu5jOw&sysid=1)

Fellow Conservative, history is being made...
In an unprecedented move, a Supreme Court decision regarding Roe v. Wade was leaked to the press. Reading the decision, it is clear the Supreme Court intends to faithfully uphold the Constitution and overturn Roe v. Wade.

49 years ago, Roe v. Wade was wrongly decided--it was an abuse of judicial power and took power away from the people. Before Roe, voters--and their elected representatives--were empowered to regulate abortion and enact pro-life laws.
* _That means power is returning to the people._
* _That means Congress and state legislatures can act to save lives._
* _That means we can save millions of babies._

But it's obvious the Left is not taking the news well. _ _ This leak appears to be a full-throated effort to inspire and empower a radical mob to put pressure on the Supreme Court Justices into changing their decision.

To further intimidate Justices, **socialist Rep. Ilhan Omar** is calling for Congress to pack the Supreme Court.

And others, like **Senator Bernie Sanders** , want to END THE FILIBUSTER and ram the “Abortion for All Act” through the Senate. _ _ These are historic battles, and we can't afford to lose them. That's why we're empowering our grassroots army now to tell legislators to STAND STRONG, defend the integrity of our courts, and protect the lives of babies. _ _ Will you chip in to fund their efforts now?

We’ve built our team, strengthened our network, and we’re prepared to defend life across this nation. **This kind of “boots-on-the-ground” grassroots organizing is only possible with your generous support. ** **We’re organized. | | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I don’t believe the majority of the public really knows what is being taught to our children and grandchildren. They assume they are taught the same lessons we learned growing up—that America is a land of freedom and opportunity where anyone has a chance at success. From what I’ve seen, this isn’t always the case. [**However, I want to know what you’ve seen.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3e7fedb9900242f4bf02b929d8fdf98b&_e=8jNftQNuvcLxNo9yar3YyGhsCOcJUPdRIAQaXqSZrzR51TekElhBciTrLLC_aEbgg8F525jiWfssESf9llimT1EGGZX2QDjtfsiCOyVViOXiUEJICMqdVT5GVTkV-v1Wgl0ox5L3bDE4dQmsKAD-s__BTZhIrkwo0u4y31kbRD-C2PFgpKcKA6B35dQ14yGnbNMTuOaNMp4vqdJnXQctXKZxL3uRqwKOm71w6qxzuhy00Cgpsuzr97ByJqQqUDBt4ASp2bIcofjAKt_I1gY28bVY5onnQC3To7GaCaCjszD23oZjpmxTbtoal_RiQQf4SBxFruhPouUPNh9nTQBriKUFNot6t5c18EFHwy93m5MJx6CcgWX8x3ZpNAceNJnjAs9bGoOl2NpA1pGy_2bYMBJor2Q1dnkYOhOwO523DP4%3D) [](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3e7fedb9900242f4bf02b929d8fdf98b&_e=8jNftQNuvcLxNo9yar3YyGhsCOcJUPdRIAQaXqSZrzR51TekElhBciTrLLC_aEbgg8F525jiWfssESf9llimT1EGGZX2QDjtfsiCOyVViOXiUEJICMqdVT5GVTkV-v1Wgl0ox5L3bDE4dQmsKAD-s__BTZhIrkwo0u4y31kbRD-C2PFgpKcKA6B35dQ14yGnbNMTuOaNMp4vqdJnXQctXP4EHIQypHkJnoVD7I0_i431Ma2F0TdzNCAaIz6XMLuCGAm-lAKXYbpQvN82qbgtuncLtUEhfp0ooQcEZgpwgKUmjuBgYleIe0CiITX9VfHY55pTZ80-7iHepqGGns1Qsu6mxg-YdjoGDiZ0smn2b33ovhPmYwUirN4Tw5C4c7Axhdd_DExn0q2W7B0WIUk6WWJb4K1_Wt7MIl6JtZFUFd8%3D)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ I believe that **children as young as elementary age are being taught to reject our American values.** They are told that our Founding Fathers were massively flawed and that it overshadows the nation they built. They hear that our Constitution is “out of date” and needs to be “modernized.” Progressives are rewriting our nation’s history and they are doing it with our youngest and most vulnerable. We cannot let this happen! This year I’m going to be meeting with political leaders and educational “experts” across the country. **I’m going to make sure people know what is really happening in our schools.** I want to be able to share with them the thoughts of people who are closest to the issue. [**Specifically, I would like to include your thoughts.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3e7fedb9900242f4bf02b929d8fdf98b&_e=8jNftQNuvcLxNo9yar3YyGhsCOcJUPdRIAQaXqSZrzR51TekElhBciTrLLC_aEbgg8F525jiWfssESf9llimT1EGGZX2QDjtfsiCOyVViOXiUEJICMqdVT5GVTkV-v1Wgl0ox5L3bDE4dQmsKAD-s__BTZhIrkwo0u4y31kbRD-C2PFgpKcKA6B35dQ14yGnbNMTuOaNMp4vqdJnXQctXGrMHZGGxP7TBenybqBoy0K3w4TcSNKiyLQSf7xU-iP3B45c9GT503VXbnWXGpqPdzF9DY3iEcAlAynRQlvjeVbC9ogomPbe5C7XfG8t94QB-KewTvN6cfOQC1RovOA6I67sCkkCx2lgOsHc4lN6TZJQ0c_mX5uRdvLyP3AYQCQBKwfS4QpdImTmzpPF6qcaE7fQNjONWA-rxYSaf83pK98%3D) The American Cornerstone Institute, a nonprofit I recently founded, has created a unique survey. We’re trying to gauge the state of America’s Educational System by surveying people like you. I’d like to ask you to give me 2 minutes of your time so we can better understand the problems that exist in our educational system. You can access the survey here...

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/education_survey/](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=3e7fedb9900242f4bf02b929d8fdf98b&_e=8jNftQNuvcLxNo9yar3YyGhsCOcJUPdRIAQaXqSZrzR51TekElhBciTrLLC_aEbgg8F525jiWfssESf9llimT1EGGZX2QDjtfsiCOyVViOXiUEJICMqdVT5GVTkV-v1Wgl0ox5L3bDE4dQmsKAD-s__BTZhIrkwo0u4y31kbRD-C2PFgpKcKA6B35dQ14yGnbNMTuOaNMp4vqdJnXQctXHYd3uG4pVbx1mPcBqajPDBknU4KfNjmWNpIHEkeVe5M6iDcylqSP5rHQGPHUfFMQ9vZeHjaF3ALeAxnfeQDy8sUumojV9zsqVqyQEJKWCiOX2Vkrh6BP9ahmTQ95taE6q1NXYVbXMjpLaq7P0oH1fn-5MVoWpj4sKqMMlkReo1oyZmiQCMWx_Gh5WpLtIHyWH9jzc1CCddSOTo-NSzgw_U%3D) Thank you for your consideration. Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
