| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45005412/344041311/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220506-b1_fr_full-MS_S2_C1&refcode=email-ngp-20220506-b1_fr_full-MS_S2_C1&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&utm_campaign=20220506&utm_content=b1_fr_full&utm_term=MS_S2_C1&amount=25&refcode2=864228c4-5ecd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjQyMjhjNC01ZWNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zRHb56tFVnUJR_tA0emQzUYpqcV1vqoB1vbN33WpY94=)

Peter, This is a long email, but it’s about my very personal experience with the rights that the Supreme Court is attacking as we speak, and I hope you’ll keep reading. If you don’t have time to read, please consider donating [_**here**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45005413/344041312/1974957641?source=email-ngp-20220506-b1_fr_full-MS_S2_C1&refcode=email-ngp-20220506-b1_fr_full-MS_S2_C1&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ngp&utm_campaign=20220506&utm_content=b1_fr_full&utm_term=MS_S2_C1&amount=25&refcode2=864228c4-5ecd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NjQyMjhjNC01ZWNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zRHb56tFVnUJR_tA0emQzUYpqcV1vqoB1vbN33WpY94=) to support our campaign to put a Democrat in the Governor’s mansion. A few days ago, news broke that the conservative majority Supreme Court drafted a majority opinion to strike down _Roe v. Wade_ , the landmark decision that enshrined the right to an abortion at the national level. **We know this ruling would be devastating to abortion access, but what the news isn’t covering is how much deeper this decision would go in restricting women’s reproductive freedom and other forms of reproductive health care like IVF (in-vitro fertilization).** _**My incredible family was only made possible because of IVF and if SCOTUS moves forward with this decision, that could mean families like mine would not be able to exist anymore.**_ When my husband and I wanted to start a family, we tried for over a year without success. Finally, we went to an infertility specialist to get poked and prodded for months trying to figure out why I couldn't get pregnant, and I still remember when the doctor told us he didn't think the typical courses of infertility treatment (like fertility meds, IUI, etc.) would work for us — and that the best chance was to go forward with IVF. He was right! After months of almost daily blood draws and learning how to give myself shots, we underwent our first round of IVF. **Four weeks later I went for a blood test and they confirmed I was pregnant.** We could hardly believe that this miracle was even possible at first. But on July 27, 2007 Braden was born (after 36+ hours of labor!!!) and he was the greatest gift we could ever ask for. subject: Cheney & Romney need to go.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HAGEMAN FOR WYOMING** [Privacy Policy](http://email
body:
Peter, By the time you read this, Liz Cheney will have finished one of the most exclusive and expensive fundraisers in the entire country - _all so she can fatten her campaign war chest to stay in power._ Worse yet - she's teamed up with the same elitist Never-Trumpers who've put fealty to Big Government over _We the People_ and the people of Wyoming: [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325598:6_q0DioNE:m:1:3253819041:B5DF8D5CB30246F3052A72F7C86C844F:r) Once again, Peter, Liz Cheney could be spending her time fighting for you against Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi's arrogant authoritarianism. But instead, she's wasting it at fancy cocktail parties with Mitt Romney, John Boehner, and the NeoCons who long ago sold out our country . . . And are clamoring for War with Russia! Is it any wonder? These career politicians are more beholden to CNN anchors than to you and me, and they'll do _anything_ to keep power. That's not me, Peter. As you know, I've spent my entire life fighting for Wyomingites against Big Government overreach, and unlike Liz Cheney, I'll actually fight for Americans like you in Congress. But first, I'll need your help to get there. [**So I must ask, Peter: Will you show your support for my America First campaign to defeat Liz Cheney with an $35 donation BEFORE the end of quarter fundraising deadline?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325598:6_q0DioNE:m:1:3253819041:B5DF8D5CB30246F3052A72F7C86C844F:r) I truly hope the answer is **YES**. And am asking you to use it to rush your donation to my campaign in the next 24 hours because we are scraping up against one of this year's most important filing deadlines. You should know we have our work cut out for us. Even before she turned to one of _**Jeb Bush's**_ top supporters to throw her recent fundraiser, Cheney reported a record-braking haul last year - and currently sits on $4.72 million dollars of elitist, Never-Trumper cash! It's not hard to see how she got it - after all, at her recent fundraiser with Mitt Romney, she charged "VIPs" over $10,000 just to attend! But what's truly scary? _**Liz Cheney raised that money by calling conservatives like you "crazies" and a "threat" to our Democracy, repeating the same old LIES that Democrats and the Media have spread.**_ I'm not going to let her get away with it, and I hope you won't either. So please, would you consider making a generous donation to my campaign to defeat her? Now, Peter, I'm not tone deaf enough to ask my supporters for $10,000 amidst Joe Biden's self-induced inflation nightmare. I know real Americans are hurting, and that every dollar I receive from patriots like you is a blessing. **[So, if you can't quite afford to make a $35 donation to my campaign, I hope you'll make the very best donation you can.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60325598:6_q0DioNE:m:1:3253819041:B5DF8D5CB30246F3052A72F7C86C844F:r)** Because while polls show Cheney is in trouble, she can still buy her way out of it - especially if Democrat donors continue to help her. So, know that if you're able to make a large donation of $1,000 or more, that will certainly bolster my campaign as we take our message to all 98 thousand square miles of Wyoming! But, whether you can give just a few dollars for small expenses, or $1,000 dollars to help with larger expenses like TV ads, the important point is that you rush back your donation within the next 24 hours. After all, Cheney's establishment backers are powerful, and the closer we get to the election, the more we can expect career politicians like Mitt Romney to try to bail her out. Your donation, and your continued support, helps me fight back. And it helps me keep momentum in this must win race for our America First Conservative movement. And in case I haven't said it enough, Peter: _Thank You._ I couldn't have made it this far without you. Your support -- especially your financial support -- is a tremendous blessing. And it will help us defeat Liz Cheney and put _We the People_ before Big Government. Peter, I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why your response to my priorities survey is so important.

Growing up, I didn’t have power or privilege. I was born in Brooklyn to hardworking parents and received all of my education through the New York City public school system. And, like millions of other New Yorkers, I had no real platform to speak up about the decisions being made that would directly affect me and my family.

I know what it is to feel powerless and voiceless. **That’s why, when I made history by becoming the first Black woman ever to be attorney general of New York, I vowed to never let another New Yorker feel voiceless.**

**Peter, I’m reaching out today to make sure you have a chance to make your voice heard:[Will you take 60 seconds now to respond to my priorities survey so I can continue to fight for what matters most to you?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45008145/344052649/447928146?email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk457-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNjJiODAxNC02N2NkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=R-hQhSj9SkMS-fZaipmvPmkCJnOkkgNtRCybQS6BfBc=&emci=5ba41930-accb-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=b62b8014-67cd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=25369504)**

**Erika Benfield Launches “ _Pro-Life Voters for Erika” _Coalition******
**Lake Mary, FL **– Erika Benfield, candidate for Congress in District 7, announced today the unveiling of the _“Pro-Life Voters for Erika”_ Coalition with the goal of uniting her pro-life supporters and activists in Central Florida who share Erika’s vision to uphold and preserve the sanctity of life in the United States Congress.
**Erika Benfield made the following statement after today’s announcement of her campaign’s _“Pro-Life Voters for Erika”_ Coalition:**
_“As a proud mother and grandmother, I am delighted to announce the launch of this critically important coalition – ‘Pro-Life Voters for Erika.’ Now, more than ever, I am greatly encouraged to have the support of so many members and activists of the pro-life movement in Central Florida, and I look forward to working closely with them as their next Congresswoman. __I am, and will always be, a devout pro-lifer who will defend the sanctity of human life in Congress and who will never sit idly by while the abortion industry and the Radical Left’s agenda continues to target our nation’s youth and wreak havoc on our society.”_ _ _**The _“Pro-Life Voters for Erika”_ Coalition has released the following statements since today’s announcement:**
“I strongly support Erika as our next Congresswoman from District 7 because she supports all women who choose life!” \- Lisa Burke, Pro-Life Advocate.
“With well over 40 years of experience in the medical field, I am very passionate about supporting a culture that embraces life. I believe in Erika because she has served our community well and will be a strong advocate and our voice for the unborn in Congress.”\- Cheryl Phenicie, Life-Long Pro-Life Advocate

I am, and will always be, a devout pro-lifer who will defend the sanctity of human life in Congress and who will never sit idly by while the abortion industry and the Radical Left’s agenda continues to target our nation’s youth and wreak havoc on our society.” The “Pro-Life Voters for Erika” Coalition has released the following statements since today’s announcement: “I strongly support Erika as our next Congresswoman from District 7 because she supports all women who choose life!” \- Lisa Burke, Pro-Life Advocate. “With well over 40 years of experience in the medical field, I am very passionate about supporting a culture that embraces life. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Becky Edwards for U
body:
Happy Mother's Day Weekend! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/68b433c413dc/a-word-to-your-mother?e=10c1db3257)
---
| | [ ](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=e9bafd4889&e=10c1db3257)
---
| Friend,

**Mothers truly make the world go round. **

In every country, state, city, and neighborhood, you will find **mothers building strong communities, cultivating compassion, and fighting for a better future. **

I want to share my appreciation for **all mothers,** because all mothers **deserve to be celebrated! **
---
| If you are...
---
| | **a single mother, a working mother, a mother far from home, a military mother, a single mother, a stay-at-home mother, a young mother, an old mother, an adoptive mother, a mother that’s lost a child, or raising your child with two mothers**
---
| **Thank you!** We see you, and **our lives are better with you!**
---
| You know, **no mother is just a mother.**

Mothers can be activists, homemakers, creatives, professionals, travelers, athletes, and craftswomen—**they can be senators. **

Team Becky is**leading this race** because of mothers, mothers who are **fighting for a better future.** I’m working to **bring better solutions** to Washington so we can **show America all the things mothers are capable of achieving. **

This mother’s day, I want to encourage us all to **listen to our mothers.** Not only when they ask you to do your chores, but when they **share their passions, their experiences, and their hardships!**

>From myself and all of the mothers on Team Becky: **we are fighting for your children, and we are fighting for you. **
---
| I asked the mothers on our staff to **share their reflections** on motherhood, politics, and the future; **here's what they had to say:**
---
| | _**Mothers want the best for their children. What changes, if any, would you like to see from our legislators to guarantee our children have access to every opportunity?**_
"After a challenging battle with cancer, I realized the legacy I wanted to leave for my children was not just what I could provide for them within the walls of my home, but what I could do to provide them with a better world, outside of our home. This realization fueled my desire to get involved in politics and to support a candidate who has the ability to work with people from all walks of life, so we can enact policies that support families and enable them to thrive.”
---
| |
---
**_What has been the most rewarding part of motherhood?_**

"The most rewarding part of motherhood is the joy you feel when your kids experience joy. I love watching them learn and grow and overcome things. I love spending time with them and laughing with them. Being their mother is my very favorite job."
---
| | _**As a member of our staff, you've dedicated countless hours to growing and maintaining this campaign, all while raising your children. What does being a working mother mean to you?**_

“My daughters have learned about the value and impact a woman can have in the world by watching me take on challenges and work hard for something (and someone) I believe in. To me, there is no greater reward than that as a working mom.”
---
| |
---
_**How has your involvement in politics influenced the ways you support and care for your children?**_

“My involvement in politics has taught my kids that my voice, and their voices are valuable in our community. My kids have learned that government is participatory and it requires all of our participation.”
---
| | _**What’s one piece of advice you would give to new mothers? To mothers entering the workforce?**_
“I would thank new mothers for the time they commit to their families. The path to becoming a contributing member of society begins in the home and mothers are an integral part of that process. To women entering the workforce: Know your boundaries; you can’t be two places at once, but you can be completely present wherever you are."
“Don’t forget yourself! Bring a mother is great but always make time for yourself. It is also important to have a healthy family and work life balance.”
---
| I want to know why you **love your mother!**

Please**submit a photo** and **share your mom's story **with us on social media @beckyforutah, or **email us at[becky@beckyforutah.com](mailto:becky@beckyforutah.com?subject=Sharing%20Her%20Story)**. We’ll be **showing our appreciation** for Utah moms everywhere by **sharing their story** **and their impact** on social media!

As always, **thank you for your support.** With **just 55 days until the Republican primary,** your support has **pushed our campaign to new heights;** thank you.

**Peter, access to quality reproductive healthcare and racial justice go hand in hand.** Black women in the United States are 3 times more likely to die from a pregnancy-related death than white women. As Ohio State House Minority Leader, Emilia worked to address this issue by founding the first Ohio Black Maternal Health Caucus, which brought leaders from across the state together to tackle this topic head-on. Peter, when I am out meeting voters and their children, I see the future of Iowa so clearly. Unfortunately, Chuck Grassley sold out after 47 years in Washington and has given up on our state’s future.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45010397/344062736/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk916-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjBmMjc3Mi02ZmNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J861SL_tlj1dvhqNsPdm2kEM70EA3aFKiYahcyJ2UOk=)
I have so much hope for Iowa's future, and being with these kids is a reminder of why we must fight for it. That's why I'm running for Senate – to create a better future for working families, for union families, and for the next generation of Iowans. **[If you're with me to defeat Sen. Chuck Grassley and expand our Democratic Senate majority, will you chip in a grassroots donation?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45010398/344062737/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk916-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjBmMjc3Mi02ZmNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J861SL_tlj1dvhqNsPdm2kEM70EA3aFKiYahcyJ2UOk=)**
I want the kids I have met across our state to grow up to attend good public schools and colleges. I want them to grow up in a place where they can access reliable, affordable healthcare for the rest of their lives. Where there's an abundance of good-paying jobs for them and their families to choose from. Where they don't have to move away from home to find opportunities. Where they can settle down with a family of their own. Where they are set up to have a great, fulfilling life.
That's my dream for Iowa’s kids – for Iowa’s future. **But we're never going to realize that future with leaders like Sen. Grassley running things.**
You see, during his 47 years in Washington, Sen. Grassley has left families like mine behind. He's blocked protections for unions, he's tried to take away our health care, and he's failed to stop more than 30,000 family farms from disappearing under his watch. **These days he's more concerned with pushing an out-of-touch right-wing agenda and doing Trump's and McConnell's bidding than he is with fighting for the people he's supposed to serve.**
Iowa deserves new leadership – and now that Sen. Grassley is facing record-low approval ratings, we've got a chance to show him the door this November. **But I need you with me to overcome the GOP's war chest of $44 million and their right-wing attacks on our campaign.** [**So please, if you believe in a better future for the next generation, can you rush $5 right here and now to defeat Sen. Best, Matt \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Matt Jacobs <matt@outreach.mattjacobsforcongress.com>
Date: Tue, May 3, 2022
Subject: Super Saturday with CAGOP Chairwoman Jessica Patterson! [](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=e4256930d2a348019b667aeef3d3026c&_e=6dGElarCQwXUYyL6CFfx2725omlZMvoTtVAbls-kq7HJfQLDv5GcnGmRqisG1gR4KQvYepxRd6Pl5XpjLC9w124bXDgdBZr_Xp3m-E_c1qAQqJv2XA0tAXQ_kUcdExO5tbSEtQUiV4Hzn-cCXaHk8O-ZAVo5WpDgBusy7M7LQxDGn4f-_b3HcvrQDnfLW6iy4DmxQyrbPFrx1ONo8Hgp0t3IwAD6eLaun6f8VeZ2jHxz25exzEN3_2jBn7YE_325F4SwYyXNVrV-Enmx-z1XZA%3D%3D) This **Super Saturday** is the most important one yet for our campaign because __ Vote-by-Mail ballots arrive next week. That’s why I’m so THRILLED to announce that California Republican Party Chairwoman Jessica Millan Patterson will be joining Team Jacobs at **Campaign HQ—1362 Thousand Oaks Blvd in Thousand Oaks—this Saturday at 9 AM** to kick off our GET-OUT-THE-VOTE efforts. [](mailto:rob@mattjacobsforcongress.com?subject=Super%20Saturday%20Event) Chairwoman Patterson knows a thing or two about winning. After all, she helped lead the successful campaign to flip FOUR California Congressional seats from **blue****** to **RED **in 2020. And she knows that we’re on track to **TAKE BACK THIS SEAT** as well come November. That’s why she’s taking time out of her extremely busy schedule to be with us this Saturday. body:
Friend, on April 27 the Washington Post Editorial Board published what I think is one of the most important national articles written to date about the stakes of Jocelyn’s re-election campaign. The headline said it all: “Michigan Republicans put truth vs. lies on this year’s ballot.”

This one’s important to read and share — I’m pasting a brief excerpt of it below, and you can click through to read the entire piece. Please take a moment and share this with someone in Michigan you think needs to hear it.
Thank you for all that you do for our campaign!

-Liz
Michigan Republicans put truth vs. lies on this year’s ballot
by the Washington Post Editorial Board
Michigan Republicans moved last weekend to put the question of truth vs. lies on the general election ballot in their state this November. Voters consequently will have an opportunity to show that mainstream America rejects the election denialism that former president Donald Trump has made GOP orthodoxy.
In a state party convention on Saturday, the Michigan Republican Party overwhelmingly endorsed Kristina Karamo for secretary of state — that is, to be Michigan’s chief elections official. Barring an extraordinary shift between now and August, when the state party’s nominations become official, Ms. Karamo will represent Michigan Republicans in November. This says nothing good about the state GOP, and it raises the prospect that Mr. Trump could install a handpicked zealot in a key position leading up to the 2024 election, making it easier for him to steal electoral votes.
A part-time community college professor, Ms. Karamo denied that Joe Biden won Michigan in 2020, though he did so by three points. She said she witnessed election fraud as a “poll challenger.” Elections experts easily debunked her claims, pointing out that she misunderstood basic terminology. Nevertheless, her assertions got her on Sean Hannity’s prime-time Fox News show as a supposed “whistleblower.” Ms. Karamo supported a lawsuit to overturn the 2020 vote in four states. She appeared last year at a Las Vegas convention featuring QAnon conspiracy theorists. And she claimed falsely that “Antifa posing as Trump supporters” staged the Jan. 6, 2021, Capitol attack.

I promise you that I will fight every single second as a Congresswoman for your right to choose – because it is not anyone’s business but your own.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45011119/344065920/489572438?refcode=em_fr_2022.05.06_b1_lm_all&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTUxNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjU0NDc5Ny03M2NkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=K4RnWf_DBupTUorWttF-Eh8xi8u18sbUgBkDSi515x4=) Hey Peter, I wanted to reach out about the recent news regarding _Roe v. Wade_ and the state of reproductive freedom in our country. If the Supreme Court’s leaked opinion reflects the Court’s final decision, it reverses _50 years of precedent_ for women to have safe, legal abortions. It means the government can ban abortions even in cases of rape, incest, and when a mother’s life is at risk. **Politicians shouldn’t be making these private healthcare decisions for women.** These are extremely personal choices that are not made lightly – and women deserve to have the space to make them without fear. Poll after poll, year after year, it is clear: The majority of Americans and Iowans want abortion to remain legal and _Roe_ to remain in place. I can’t sit here and promise you that this decision won’t happen. Republicans have been going after _Roe_ for decades, and this time, the court is in their favor. But we are not going down without a hell of a fight. I promise you that I will do everything in my power as a Congresswoman to protect your right to choose – because it is not anyone’s business but your own. Former Pelosi Staffer Claims Voters Don’t Care About U.S. House Speaker; Asks “What Does it Matter” As Families Face Historic Inflation and Rising Cri **CHABOT CAMPAIGN SLAMS LANDSMAN FOR COMMENTS ON FORMER BOSS PELOSI; DISREGARD FOR****DISASTROUS** **IMPACT OF PELOSI AGENDA ON OH-01****FAMILIES** _Former Pelosi Staffer Claims Voters Don’t Care About U.S. House Speaker; Asks “What Does it Matter” As Families Face Historic Inflation and Rising Crime_ **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: Jon Conradi Email: jconradi@fp1strategies.com **CINCINNATI –** Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign issued the following statement Friday reacting to comments from out-of-touch Congressional candidate and former Nancy Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman. “Nancy Pelosi’s extreme partisan agenda has hit hardworking families in Ohio’s First District with disastrous results, including rising crime and out-of-control costs for everyday essentials like groceries and gas,” said Chabot campaign manager John Gomez. “But to former Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman, ‘what does it matter?’” “Landsman, like his mentor Pelosi, has exposed himself as having a callous disdain for the intelligence and best interests of hardworking families and small businesses,” Gomez continued. “As a city councilor, Landsman wrote Pelosi-inspired policies to defund the Cincinnati police and hit struggling small businesses with costly mandates — now, he’s desperate to downplay the disastrous impact of his former boss’s radical agenda so he can get to Washington and vote to keep her in power. Unfortunately for Landsman, voters do care, very much, who will control the levers of government in the U.S. House next year and what their policies mean for their families.” In an interview this week, Landsman told the Cincinnati Enquirer, “the voters in the 1st Congressional District don't care about Pelosi... name: Ben Carson
subject: Stand for those with no voice
body:

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [[](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJx9UE1rwzAM_TXJLcGxE3c95FAouXWMMdjRqI6cmvoj2Ar7-3PaDXYa6CLpvaenN4-znqHTtR0545wNTHbD0LFjy7Xh7IAdIMyaCax6Bg4TtQnX7eqshkCQ7yYmja2Ovr6NRh5Ef5XY9TCYQRoDzIiX_noEaRB6Vn9e1AWss2F5BY9jIqNSVgEUaNs4a1ANjWw4V7x2441ozZU4VXwqFY3BlNtCS_tpHVMoPcWAbUxLAawpPiSaTEDoMdBOFNNGXuW4FZeVOBdQXlFTcVBxua88znbzZYW-OPsZavAr2CU8Gerh7I_sExMD7Z04v52a94-p-c2vTuO8flnnbJaHktqyCz8Sov8-_gZ6tYTC)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJx9UE1rwzAM_TXJLcGxE3c95FAouXWMMdjRqI6cmvoj2Ar7-3PaDXYa6CLpvaenN4-znqHTtR0545wNTHbD0LFjy7Xh7IAdIMyaCax6Bg4TtQnX7eqshkCQ7yYmja2Ovr6NRh5Ef5XY9TCYQRoDzIiX_noEaRB6Vn9e1AWss2F5BY9jIqNSVgEUaNs4a1ANjWw4V7x2441ozZU4VXwqFY3BlNtCS_tpHVMoPcWAbUxLAawpPiSaTEDoMdBOFNNGXuW4FZeVOBdQXlFTcVBxua88znbzZYW-OPsZavAr2CU8Gerh7I_sExMD7Z04v52a94-p-c2vTuO8flnnbJaHktqyCz8Sov8-_gZ6tYTC) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJx9UE1rwzAM_TXJLcGxE3c95FAouXWMMdjRqI6cmvoj2Ar7-3PaDXYa6CLpvaenN4-znqHTtR0545wNTHbD0LFjy7Xh7IAdIMyaCax6Bg4TtQnX7eqshkCQ7yYmja2Ovr6NRh5Ef5XY9TCYQRoDzIiX_noEaRB6Vn9e1AWss2F5BY9jIqNSVgEUaNs4a1ANjWw4V7x2441ozZU4VXwqFY3BlNtCS_tpHVMoPcWAbUxLAawpPiSaTEDoMdBOFNNGXuW4FZeVOBdQXlFTcVBxua88znbzZYW-OPsZavAr2CU8Gerh7I_sExMD7Z04v52a94-p-c2vTuO8flnnbJaHktqyCz8Sov8-_gZ6tYTC) Regards,

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive. Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? Regards, Dr. Ben Carson Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute | | Your donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our country’s most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods to decrease the federal government’s role in society and to improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation’s citizens. | | Copyright © 2022 American Cornerstone Institute, All rights reserved._ This message was originally sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com Sent to Republican Task Force subscribers. body:
I have always been and will continue to remain committed to protecting Social Security and Medicare.
Peter, I have some exciting news to share: the National Committee to Preserve Social Security & Medicare has endorsed our campaign!
They work tirelessly to protect, preserve, and ensure the financial well-being of all Americans, and I'm proud to have their support. No matter your political affiliation, we should all want to ensure that seniors can retire with dignity.

Quality health care is necessary for a high quality of life. That's why I voted for legislation that would finally allow Medicare to negotiate prices for high-cost drugs with pharmaceutical manufacturers and allow Medicare to provide partial coverage for hearing services.

I am also incredibly proud to be an original co-sponsor of the Social Security 2100 Act to extend Social Security's solvency for more than 75 years and simultaneously improve benefits. I have always been and will continue to remain committed to protecting Social Security and Medicare - two of the most successful public policy programs in the history of this country.

I know that Social Security and Medicare are vital to the well-being of our nation, as well as to the economy of Washington's 6th congressional district. **I earned a 100% record on the National Committee 's voting scoreboard last Congress, and I plan to do so again.**

As always, it's an honor to represent you,

Derek Kilmer

It’s time to celebrate this work before the campaign season. _Snag your tickets here:**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh2022](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45011807/344070841/-1823536925?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYTU1YTQyNS03N2NkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SYOJrrcOlkfU77I2oDSFMP2VnzibgRuxrz6KRqYB2xI=)**_ _Make your overnight reservations**[here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45011818/344070865/1351751907?src=envision_email_grpreserv_ENG_20210804_GroupBooking_TC000000170A000007762ENG_G-_93048&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYTU1YTQyNS03N2NkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SYOJrrcOlkfU77I2oDSFMP2VnzibgRuxrz6KRqYB2xI=&emci=dfa5473e-67cd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=2a55a425-77cd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535)**_ **\- INDems Statement on May 3 Primary Elections -** _“Indiana’s top businesses have acknowledged that the state is no longer ‘A State that Works’ but a state experiencing a race to the bottom. Our state has an F-rated workforce, an F-rated quality of life, a D+ rated education system, and is the most polluted state in the nation. Those are the facts. Democrats are telling it straight because state Republicans have spent the last two decades with absolutely no plan for Indiana’s future – just national partisanship. _ _Thanks to the American Rescue Plan and the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, Hoosiers are getting a taste of a brighter future made possible by Indiana Democrats. Good-paying jobs and regional economic investments are returning to every corner of the state. A renewed commitment to organized labor and Indiana’s traditional industries - like steel - are priorities. Adequate funding has returned to our public school system, and educators finally received a pay raise. Indiana’s childcare crisis is finally being addressed. Broadband access is expanding across the state, our roads and bridges are seeing much-needed repairs, and the state’s water systems are getting a necessary overhaul to improve overall public health._ _Democrats have delivered where it seems the only thing Indiana Republicans care about is following a gameplan set by those in Washington. GOP Chairman Kyle Hupfer himself admitted the Indiana GOP works ‘hand in hand’ with the Republican National Committee – and recent legislation that bullies children, disrespects state law enforcement, and puts politics in our classrooms proves it. Indiana Republicans do not have a plan for Hoosiers, and the primary elections showed how the other side has sadly lost its way into extremism._ _The choice for the upcoming state and federal elections couldn’t be more stark, and Indiana Democrats are determined to elect a new generation of leaders who will help correct this path charted by a Republican Party and an era of government where power and control has come before serving Hoosier workers and families.” **\- Mike Schmuhl, Indiana Democratic Party Chairman**_
**\- Todd Young, Jennifer-Ruth Green Need to Clarify Position on Abortion -** The Indiana Democratic Party wants to be very clear: ending Roe v. Wade does not end abortions. It ends access to safe and legal abortions – especially for vulnerable communities nationwide. A total ban on abortions would be dangerous and would unnecessarily put lives at risk. name: Dr. Neil Shah For Governor
subject: Blessed With A Forth Child - This is Why We Fight!!
body:
| Peter -- This week my family was blessed with our fourth child. In such a profoundly humbling moment, I am once again reminded of why we fight. Like so many other parents across Minnesota and across America, I am deeply concerned about the state and the country Dessa Grace Shah will inherit from us. I am concerned about how the actions of an elite few are already disenfranchising future generations. Politicians give great speeches on returning the surplus, stopping the mandates, and cleaning up our streets. Their actions tell a very different story. Paul Gazelka, a career politician who is somehow running for governor as a Republican, has **already voted to give over $1 Billion of your surplus money to Walz** through an unconstitutional omnibus spending bill. Almost every single legislator of both parties has voted to start spending your surplus. Few have taken real action on ending mandates and emergency powers. Fewer yet are serious about actually shrinking the size of government. While career politicians talk about school choice, they **bend the knee to teachers unions** and special interests, happily voting year after year to provide a rapidly expanding budget to Minnesota Department of Education. We cannot afford to trust the political class to protect our children from out of control debt and inflation, mandates, and surges in violent crime. _I am not willing to stand idly by as career politicians perpetuate indoctrination in schools, spend away our children's futures, and attack Liberty._ **You** should not be willing to accept this either. We conservatives must demand better from our elected officials, because there is much more than my life and yours at stake. This is why we fight. Not for only for our own liberties, but for the life, liberty, and prosperity of future generations. We are continuing to secure victories each and every day we fight together. I have consistently called out Senators Jensen and Gazelka for **[supporting](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=fC4tS59abWPkKoho6fpdBaxgivC3ew34aXVRl71bKPtFcshlOz21TOxCbwdT-5BKdttvnoO1Ty4RjvObmGo6UrC6OAIXamNic365Tjp0Paw6t2FdxdlseK9BXJYYKvi5J0dgQ1IbssPIGmhxGikR4g&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=supreme_court_and_life_in_mn&n=1) **Unconstitutional Omnibus Bills that funded Planned Parenthood's slaughter of unborn Minnesotans. In the swamp of Saint Paul, this practice was commonplace on both sides of the aisle, as many weak Republican politicians considered cutting Planned Parenthood funding an unattainable goal. Fortunately, we now see MCCL and Rep. Demuth taking up the challenge. Thanks to the tireless efforts of pro-life groups, we are making progress toward ending the awful practice of infanticide. A Pro-Life Minnesota is only an election away but we have to nominate the **right candidate**. **Imagine what we can accomplish with a true conservative outsider in the governor's office.** I will defeat Tim Walz by bringing in new, disaffected voters, just like we’ve already done throughout this endorsement process. We need a candidate who thinks and speaks differently than the career political class if we want a **different result**! Once we beat Tim Walz I will keep adhering to my principles - My message now will be my message as your Governor. This is a **golden opportunity** to restore dignity and honor to our state. Other candidates will let it slip through their fingers, [**I will continue to Champion Life**](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRYMkSqpzuaGvFMrbR7zh1Cy&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=supreme_court_and_life_in_mn&n=2) while serving in Governor’s office. With your First Round vote at the State Convention, we will secure the endorsement, beat Tim Walz, and Save Sota! If you're not attending the state convention, please consider [donating to our campaign](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rDwg01bMOn9gGWui5cl2dLg&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=supreme_court_and_life_in_mn&n=3) to restore Life and Liberty to Minnesota, while there is still time. Stay focused in the fight and our cause will be victorious! Thank you! Dr. Neil Shah Conservative Candidate for Governor [ElectNeil.com](https://electneil.nationbuilder.com/r?u=iUaD1gacZHU3dYzSqkV0rOkbRklTyTNtmBTRPmVdijk&e=d39b8e369eb2bbdd6f36e913aaadeb34&utm_source=electneil&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=supreme_court_and_life_in_mn&n=4)

subject: this is my story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
Friend, my story is one of community. It made me who I am today, and it's why I fight so hard for Nevada in the Senate.
| | |

The little girl in this photo has no clue what a wild ride life has in store for her. Right now, all she knows is the joy of weekend camping with her family, tearing into her mom’s homemade meatballs and begging her dad to buy her a dirt bike.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45012212/344073701/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1763-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzVmZTk4OS03OGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ij0Kz4ZcGao7mPBOXXHCcRSi-lU1Ofd5pQiM1Nt-DpI=)
Her dad raised her on three principles: work hard, be honest and respect everyone. She spent her life watching him pour his heart into bettering his community, and she became a first-generation college graduate and pursued a career in law to protect that community.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45012213/344073702/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1763-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzVmZTk4OS03OGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ij0Kz4ZcGao7mPBOXXHCcRSi-lU1Ofd5pQiM1Nt-DpI=)
She went on to be elected Nevada’s attorney general just as the 2008 financial crisis wreaked havoc on America’s middle-class families and our economy. She took on the Big Banks with a fellow attorney general from California and secured $1.9 billion in relief for Nevada homeowners.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45012214/344073703/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1763-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzVmZTk4OS03OGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ij0Kz4ZcGao7mPBOXXHCcRSi-lU1Ofd5pQiM1Nt-DpI=)
In 2016, she would make history as the first woman from Nevada and first Latina ever elected to the United States Senate. The odds were stacked against her, and many said she had no chance of winning. Mitch McConnell and the GOP spent nearly $50 million to defeat her, but her grassroots team stood by her every step of the way.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45012215/344073704/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1763-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzVmZTk4OS03OGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ij0Kz4ZcGao7mPBOXXHCcRSi-lU1Ofd5pQiM1Nt-DpI=)
Friend, my story is one of community. It made me who I am today, and it's why I fight so hard for Nevada in the Senate. People doubted that a Latina could compete and overcome the odds to win. I’ve proven them wrong every time, and I know that with your help, I can do it again.
**But right now, Donald Trump’s handpicked candidate is leading me by 3 points in the polls, and FiveThirtyEight's Nate Silver says I’m in serious danger of losing this toss-up race. Protecting my Democratic seat in Nevada is _crucial_ for defending our Senate majority. That's why GOP outside groups have already spent more than $4 million to defeat me, and it's why I have to ask:**
**[Will you chip in $5 now – split between Jacky Rosen and me – to help defeat my Trump-endorsed opponent, defend my seat in Nevada and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45012216/344073705/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1763-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzVmZTk4OS03OGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ij0Kz4ZcGao7mPBOXXHCcRSi-lU1Ofd5pQiM1Nt-DpI=)**

name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: Join Bernie and chip in for Summer Lee
body:
Bernie raised money for Summer Lee this week, but we’re up against millions of dollars in corporate spending.
#
Peter, establishment Super PACs have already spent almost $2 million against Summer Lee in her primary against a corporate Democrat.
Here’s what Bernie Sanders had to say about that this week, in an email raising money for Summer:
_"The Democratic Corporate Establishment is spending a huge amount of money trying to defeat strong, progressive women of color who are running for Congress. Given the recent news about the Supreme Court's willingness to overturn Roe v. Wade, we need these women in Congress more than ever._
_What this super PAC is doing is disgusting and speaks to the corruption of our political system. When we talk about billionaires and big money buying elections, this is exactly what we are talking about. These big money interests will do and spend whatever it takes to try to stop our progressive movement. We must fight back."_
[Peter, can you join Bernie today and contribute to Summer Lee’s campaign before her May 17 primary? Rush a split contribution to Summer and Justice Democrats right now.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105878?refcode=em20220506-23220&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=23220%2E1203867%2Ey9lLfr)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105878?refcode=em20220506-23220&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=23220%2E1203867%2Ey9lLfr)**
Super PACs are spending millions to stop our candidates because the establishment is doing everything it can to protect the corporate-backed status quo. The establishment is backing Summer’s opponent, who made money as a corporate lawyer defending companies accused of withholding unpaid wages and sexual discrimination. Summer, a progressive fighter for the people, is the clear choice in PA-12, but not for the corporate establishment.
Here’s one more thing from Bernie: _"It is not an accident that Congress is now a bolder and more progressive institution than in past years. Together, we've made that happen by taking on the political establishment and electing some great progressive leaders. It is very important that we continue that progress."_
Justice Democrats has been a huge (or 'yuge' as Bernie would say) part of making Congress a bolder, more progressive institution. We recruited AOC and helped her build a winning campaign in 2018. We recruited and helped elect Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman. We helped re-elect the Squad. **Summer is our next chance to expand our Justice Democrats bloc in Congress.**
[Can you join Bernie today by chipping in to Summer’s campaign and Justice Democrats? We have to battle the millions the establishment is spending to defeat Summer.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105878?refcode=em20220506-23220&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=23220%2E1203867%2Ey9lLfr)
Justice Democrats formed after Bernie’s 2016 presidential campaign in order to elect more members of Congress that reflected Bernie’s policy agenda. We’ve had some huge wins since then, and we need another one on May 17.
Let’s send Summer to Congress.
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=22&akid=23220%2E1203867%2Ey9lLfr) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=23&akid=23220%2E1203867%2Ey9lLfr) and your state public health department.
---

# It's time to put a stop this rampant inflation and turn the economy around.
---
|
---
| | | President Joe Biden asserts our economy is in good health, even stating that it is "stronger than before the outbreak." If that is the case, where is this "strong" economy Biden cites? It is not being felt by the American people - it is not being felt in Georgia.

Inflation, on the other hand, is out of control and driving up prices for consumers and small businesses alike. I'm sure like me, you suffer from sticker shock every time you visit the pump.

Biden's administration talks about increased salaries for Americans, but it fails to highlight that inflation has risen faster than wage growth. On an annualized basis, real average hourly wages have decreased by 1.7%.

Many initiatives supported by President Biden have actually made the economy worse, despite the administration's claims that this crisis will soon be solved.

Today, higher prices and wage stagnation are putting a strain on American households and companies across the country and here in our home state of Georgia. These are the results of Democrat policies that Congress and President Biden have promoted.

**We need strong, new leadership - a bold leader committed to lowering inflation, boosting the economy, and helping both families and businesses alike.

That leader is Alan Sims.**

It's time to make a change for the better - it's time to **Vote Alan Sims for Congress.**

Primary voting has started and ends on May 24th!

Hello, This week, the Supreme Court’s draft decision to overturn Roe v. Wade was leaked. **And Tuesday night, we found out my GOP opponent is right-wing, anti-abortion extremist, JD Vance.** Overturning Roe would be catastrophic for Ohio, where Republicans have introduced one extreme proposal after another to ban abortion before most women even know they're pregnant. Our work has never been more important than right now. A 50/50 Senate has failed to protect abortion for people across the country. body:
On Tuesday, our process server, who under President Trump's command, has literally hunted down terrorists around the world as a Special Operations operator known as "the Bobcat," rolled up to Jack Dorsey's house after flying into San Francisco.

On Tuesday, our process server, who under President Trump's command, has literally hunted down terrorists around the world as a Special Operations operator known as "the Bobcat," rolled up to Jack Dorsey's house after flying into San Francisco.

Jack wasn't home, as his house is currently under construction, **but four GIANT plain-clothed private security contractors were** \-- and they quickly surrounded our guy, demanded his identification, and began recording him.

Thankfully, t**he Bobcat isn 't easily intimidated and laughed it off and gained some intel from the encounter** before heading over to Facebook and serving their corporate offices.

From there, the Bobcat hit Dorsey's company, Square, and gained even more intel. Dorsey once claimed that he walks to work each day, but according to the intel we collected, he's not making that hilly, 12-mile round trip very often, if at all. Long-time employees at Square told the Bobcat that they have only seen Dorsey in person about three times!

And when he does show up, he comes and goes in his bright white Tesla Model 3, compliments of his buddy, Elon Musk . . . you know, the same Elon Musk who just purchased Twitter!

After gathering as much info as possible and following leads, the Bobcat flew out to L.A., and yesterday morning, he hit the ground running to serve the Registered Agent for Twitter with our federal RICO complaint.

**I can 't say where the Bobcat is heading next, but he's on the trail to hunt down Jack and Zuck!**

[Will you help cover the Bobcat's travel costs that are climbing daily so we can hold these tech tyrants accountable?](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/892HauOjLKv0mwgokZrTTakw/BdobtdbXm0kFPZ5763YZ2X3w)

Between several flights, discounted hotels, rental cars (the Bobcat had to ditch one of the rental cars because he was followed by Jack's security), and gas, costs are closing in on $4,000.

[Please donate today so we can personally serve Jack and Zuck in record time!](https://libersend.loomered.com/l/bZPeCTAajmzyaMKwCIY0iA/892HauOjLKv0mwgokZrTTakw/BdobtdbXm0kFPZ5763YZ2X3w)

Tracking and hunting down criminals and digital terrorists isn't easy, but it must be done, **and we 've hired the best in the world to get the job done**.

Thanks so much for all that you do.

Respectfully,

Laura Loomer

# Want to take a walk down memory lane?
Here are some of our favorite interviews with Alexandria you may have missed:
---
| [ ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13640?t=2&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) | 1
## [Alexandria wins her primary](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13640?t=3&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) \- The Late Show with Stephen Colbert
In one of her first big, national TV interviews after the primary, Alexandria talked about the moment she found out that she won the election and what Democratic socialism means to her.
---|---
| [ ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13641?t=4&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) | 2
## [Alexandria’s Guide to Her Signature Red Lip](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13641?t=5&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) \- Vogue
Alexandria takes Vogue through her beauty routine, and shares some key advice: “If you’re feeling particularly challenged that day, look in the mirror and say, ‘I’m the bomb’ and I will make the world a better place.”
---|---
| [ ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13642?t=6&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) | 3
## [Alexandria on her time working in restaurants](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13642?t=7&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) \- Yahoo Finance
Alexandria shares how her time as a waitress was politically formative and describes how restaurants are a crucible of so many different public policies.
---|---
| [ ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13643?t=8&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) | 3
## [Ta-Nehisi Coates interview with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13643?t=9&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) \- MLK Now 2020
On MLK Day, Alexandria sat down with Ta-Nehisi Coates to discuss the legacy of Martin Luther King Jr. and how we can apply his lessons to today. They discuss activism, organizing, and the in-the-trenches work of being in the streets.
---|---
| [ ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13644?t=10&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) | 3
## [Alexandria reacts to seeing the numbers on primary night](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13644?t=11&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq) \- NY1
In her first interview after seeing election results, Alexandria reacts to the news and thanks the grassroots organizers who made this victory possible. Only one TV outlet, NY1, was at her victory party.
---|---
| [ ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/13159?t=12&akid=3008%2E2526796%2EJD7jZq)

name: Peter Welch
subject: The filibuster has to go
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
It’s time to abolish the filibuster. It continues to undermine our democracy.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=359%2E61531%2E7Xgocw)
Hello,
This week, we found out that the Supreme Court is planning to overturn _Roe v. Wade_. But we can overcome their extremist agenda if we make one basic change to the Senate rules. Here’s how:
I’ve cosponsored the Women’s Health Protection Act (WHPA), which passed the House and would codify abortion rights nationwide, no matter what the Supreme Court does to Roe. But to get this legislation through the Senate, we need to get rid of the filibuster—which has let the Republican minority block critical bills like the WHPA from passing.
[**We must eliminate the filibuster to protect abortion rights. Add your name to our petition right away if you agree.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster/?source=em_20220506_p_p_filibuster&t=3&akid=359%2E61531%2E7Xgocw)
Even with Democrats holding the majority, the filibuster allows for minority rule. Senate Republicans haven’t just filibustered the WHPA—they’ve also filibustered raising the minimum wage, protecting the right to vote, and passing common-sense gun safety reform.
These are broadly popular, badly needed bills that I’ve fought to get through the House. But Mitch McConnell has been able to filibuster them to death.
**The filibuster has to go. It’s a relic that Jim Crow defenders used to block civil rights, it still undermines our democracy, and it’s time to abolish it.**
**If I become Vermont’s next senator, I will vote to end the filibuster so we can protect Americans’ basic rights and deliver results for families. But I can’t win this fight by myself—we all need to raise our voices.**
[**Add your name right away to say it’s time to get rid of the filibuster.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster/?source=em_20220506_p_p_filibuster&t=4&akid=359%2E61531%2E7Xgocw)
Thanks,
Peter

I’m so angry I can hardly type this message to you, friend: Breaking-news reports say that the Supreme Court is set to overturn Roe v. Wade and that they could make that ruling official soon. It’s our worst nightmare coming true – the END of Roe v. Wade.
I ain’t gonna lie to you: The Senate is now our LAST line of defense. **If Catherine Cortez Masto loses in Nevada, MAGA extremists will retake the Senate and you can kiss the RIGHT TO PRIVACY good-bye! They could punish women in every corner of this country – from coast to coast!**
In my expert opinion, Catherine is the most vulnerable Democratic senator in the entire country. body:

#### **Barrett Holds Veteran Roundtable with Congresswoman Mariannette Miller-Meeks (IA-2)**
I hosted a veteran roundtable in Livingston County with Congresswoman Mariannette Miller-Meeks, who served 24 years as an Army Nurse and doctor. It was great to have a chance to have a discussion with veterans in our district about the issues that matter most to them. We need fighters in Congress who will work tirelessly for our veterans. When I get to congress I will join Congresswoman Miller-Meeks in this fight to address the problems facing our veterans. See more [here](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=627557b11d308c3809e29e70&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fbarrettbrigade1%2Fposts%2F442129287721483&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=cx33i0eTKeMuNdxuxTKtAosTB9w%3D).

---
|
---
#### **Door Knocking in Okemos**
I got to spend my birthday knocking on doors in Okemos. I believe that the best way to connect with voters is talking to them face to face at their doorstep. The issues they expressed included inflation, gas prices, crime, national security, and others. We are all feeling the weight of these in our own lives, that’s why we are digging into them in this campaign. I look forward to meeting many more voters across the district and to be their voice in Washington. See more[ here. ](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=627557b11d308c3809e29e70&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fbarrettbrigade1%2Fvideos%2F1229932140879956&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=lkNEVuP8EKNbyibBMMmZJYIHr_Y%3D)

#### **Louis Joins the Senate Floor**
It was a long week in Lansing voting on the state budget - but thankfully I had a special visitor to help keep me company. Louis made his first appearance on the senate floor and Senator LaSata and Johnson made sure to spoil him!See more[ here. ](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=627557b11d308c3809e29e70&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fbarrettbrigade1%2Fposts%2F441309354470143&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=wEYcVLoMz5hPdVNkLEgQYWWGmpw%3D)

Our campaign is in full swing. We have already knocked on thousands of doors in the district, thanks to our grassroots supporters in the Barrett Brigade. * I’m the only candidate in this primary who is a **proud union member** and will _always_ fight to protect worker rights. Unfortunately, one of our opponents has even coordinated directly with one of the union-busting consulting firms that’s sold out working Montanans.
* Most importantly, I’m the **only candidate in this primary who can defeat Ryan Zinke** in November because our campaign isn’t going to make the same mistakes Democrats have made in previous elections in our state.

You’ve been with our campaign every step of the way, and I am so grateful for your support. But with the establishment trying to ensure their hand-picked candidate wins this primary, we MUST have a strong showing at tonight’s debate.

# National Rifle Association awards Bill McSwain its highest rating
_McSwain's AQ rating is the highest possible for first-time candidates _
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today announced that he has [been awarded ](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=c21c90a08b&e=b1ec95759b)the rating of 'AQ' by the National Rifle Association (NRA). The AQ grade is the highest possible for any first-time candidate.

McSwain has promised to uphold Second Amendment rights as Governor, including by supporting constitutional carry. McSwain had this to say in response to his AQ rating:
---
|
> _**"As a Marine infantry officer, I am a strong supporter of the Second Amendment. Law-abiding citizens have the Constitutional right to defend themselves and their families and that right is every bit as important as any other right in the Bill of Rights.
>
> I also know that strengthening gun rights for law-abiding citizens actually reduces crime. That’s why we often see the highest rates of crime in those areas with the strictest gun control laws. And we also see the lowest rates of crime in communities with the strongest Second Amendment protections. As Governor, I will always stand with the Second Amendment.**__**" **_
---
|
---
| To watch McSwain discuss second amendment and constitutional carry, [click here](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=6f530bb327&e=b1ec95759b).
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=9bac4e7092&e=b1ec95759b)

clean_body: McSwain has promised defend second amendment rights as Governor. | | | | | | PRESS RELEASE FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE May 6, 2021 CONTACT: Rachel Tripp 202.738.9089 | | National Rifle Association awards Bill McSwain its highest rating McSwain's AQ rating is the highest possible for first-time candidates West Chester, Pa. \-- Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today announced that he has rating of 'AQ' by the National Rifle Association (NRA). The AQ grade is the highest possible for any first-time candidate. McSwain has promised to uphold Second Amendment rights as Governor, including by supporting constitutional carry. McSwain had this to say in response to his AQ rating: | "As a Marine infantry officer, I am a strong supporter of the Second Amendment. Law-abiding citizens have the Constitutional right to defend themselves and their families and that right is every bit as important as any other right in the Bill of Rights. I also know that strengthening gun rights for law-abiding citizens actually reduces crime. That’s why we often see the highest rates of crime in those areas with the strictest gun control laws. And we also see the lowest rates of crime in communities with the strongest Second Amendment protections. As Governor, I will always stand with the Second Amendment." _ | | To watch McSwain discuss second amendment and constitutional carry, . | | BACKGROUND: Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. Peter,

As you know, I challenged a career politician in 2020 who has been in D.C. since 1986. I narrowly lost that race – **by just about 5 points** – after Nancy Pelosi spent more than $5 million on defense.

Now, Peter DeFazio is calling it quits and has endorsed the Oregon Labor Commissioner to replace him in D.C.

Over the last several months we’ve seen a groundswell of support from every corner of the country. From Republican leaders in Washington, D.C., to folks in Oregon’s 4th district, t**o the more than 9,000 conservatives who have made a contribution to help me flip this seat Republican** for the first time since 1975.

The Republican primary on May 17th is fast approaching, and it’s the goal of my campaign to build as much momentum as we can before then. I'm hoping to get 1,000 conservatives to personally endorse my campaign before May 17th (Primary Day). **Would you do me the honor of signaling your endorsement of my candidacy today?**

Not from Oregon? Let me tell you why you should pay attention to this race.
* Donald Trump only narrowly lost my district – **by LESS THAN 1/10 percent in 2016**

* If we flip this seat, it’s a good sign that Republicans will take back the House.

**Team Tom Weekly Update | Friday, May 6th, 2022**
Peter,
The energy at our Baltimore Office Opening on Sunday was incredible! Between a marching band kick off, passionate speeches from leaders like Senator Cory McCray, Delegate Luke Clippinger, and Councilman Ryan Dorsey, and being surrounded by hundreds of our supporters from across the state, #TeamPerezSneed was fired up and ready to bring change to our state.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45014831/344085532/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTc0ZmI5Ny04NmNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uF6jq_eSWR4bFj1ILtCZ4_ohoTUT7oC7hzd2l3YhROE=&emci=81edfda2-75cd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=9974fb97-86cd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)
To make an exciting day even better, Tom and Shannon were proud to stand alongside Baltimore City Councilman for the 13th District, Antonio Glover, as he formally announced his support for our campaign.
Thank you all for your outpouring of support. We can build a better Maryland, and we will do it together.
All the best,
Team Tom
* * *
**On the Campaign Trail**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45014832/344085533/1083112743?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTMyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OTc0ZmI5Ny04NmNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uF6jq_eSWR4bFj1ILtCZ4_ohoTUT7oC7hzd2l3YhROE=&emci=81edfda2-75cd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=9974fb97-86cd-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=14684837)

Join the McSwain for Governor team as we make calls to help elect Bill McSwain, this Saturday 5/7! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billmcswain/tomorrow-mcswain-for-governor-phone-banking?e=b1ec95759b)

##
Bill McSwain for Governor: Second Volunteer Day of Action Is On Saturday!
May 06, 2022 Good afternoon, McSwain supporters!

**Tomorrow, May 7,** we will have our second volunteer Day of Action!

Due to the rain, we will be**calling voters** in Chester County at the Chester County Republican Committee HQ.
---
| _The Day of Action schedule is as follows_ : **Date:** Saturday, May 7, 9:00AM - 4:00PM

**Address:** 15 S Church Street, West Chester, PA, 19382

**Parking Information:** Street parking is available

**9:00AM:** Meet at Chester County GOP Headquarters, 15 S Church Street, West Chester, PA, 19382

**9:00AM -10:00AM:** We will share instructions on phone banking and talking to voters. We will also be giving you a list of Republican homes to call.

**Note:** If you arrive after 10:00AM and miss the instructions, we will have a staffer at the office to assist you all day, 10:00AM-4:00pm.

**10:00AM-4:00PM:** Phone-banking! We will be in the back room calling republican voters in Chester county. Please bring your cell phone and we will give you a list to call.

_Donuts, coffee, and water will be available. _

Please email me at [Derek@billmcswain.com](mailto:derek@billmcswain.com?subject=I%20am%20attending%20the%205%2F7%20%20volunteer%20day%20of%20action%20&body=I%20am%20attending%20the%20volunteer%20day%20of%20action%20on%20behalf%20of%20Bill%20McSwain%20for%20Governor%20on%20Saturday%2C%20May%207%20at%209am) to let us know we can count on you for tomorrow!

Can't make it to Chester County? If you would like to make phone calls for Bill in another county, please reach out and let us know what county and we will send you a list and some instructions!

We look forward to seeing you on Saturday and appreciate your time!
Thank you,

Derek Rockey
Field Director
Bill McSwain for Governor
717-706-2719

Dear Friend,

We knew it was coming, but still...

The new Supreme Court draft opinion that shows its plan to overturn Roe v. Wade is horrifying. If ever there was a time to raise our voices, it's now.

Our partners at the ACLU of PA are asking us to join them in this fight for our right to control our bodies and our futures. Sign up TODAY to become an Abortion Care Champion, because we can make a bigger difference when we work together.

TAKE ACTION [https://www.aclupa.org/en/abortioncarechampions]

Many of us will be taking to the streets to protest – including on May 14, when coordinated marches are being planned. When we protest, it’s imperative to know how to protect ourselves in case a conflict arises. That's why we're also sharing the ACLU's detailed information on your rights as a protester.

KNOW YOUR RIGHTS [https://www.aclupa.org/en/know-your-rights/know-your-rights-protest]

We’ll see you in the streets and at the polls — because we’re not giving up this fight for abortion liberation. Not now, not ever!

Angela Valvano
Keystone Progress

Hello,

This is one of the most difficult emails I’ve had to write.

The 50-year precedent set by _Roe v. Wade_ is on the verge of being overturned. The Supreme Court’s draft decision leaked Monday night would overturn the basic right to abortion and bodily autonomy.

**I won’t mince words: A woman’s right to make her own health care decisions is under a full-fledged attack at the Supreme Court - and in states like New Hampshire.**
Anticipating the end of _Roe_ , partisan politicians across the country are launching unprecedented efforts to eviscerate reproductive rights.

In state legislatures, Republicans have passed legislation defunding Planned Parenthood, banning abortion, and mandating unnecessary ultrasounds.

Republicans are also fighting harder than ever to flip swing seats like mine to pack the Senate with anti-choice policymakers.

I will always keep fighting to protect reproductive rights - no matter what attacks come my way. **[Will you join me by rushing an urgent donation of $3 or any amount to my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45015881/344089541/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk992-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzllOWM5Yi04OGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_WlYiP8KPfOljwoBYUAG9fG4bayA3pmbSFyC2BaCTTc=)**
I’m committing to seeing this fight through, but I can’t do it without your support.

**My team often says we don’t need every single person reading an email to take action. Today, that’s not true. The stakes are just too high for anyone to sit on the sidelines**.

If you donate to just one email today, please make it this one. I won my last race by just 1,017 votes. **Losing this seat could cost us our best line of defense in this fight: the Senate majority.**

Here is the link to give: **[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/hassan_email_mw](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45015882/344089542/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk992-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzllOWM5Yi04OGNkLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_WlYiP8KPfOljwoBYUAG9fG4bayA3pmbSFyC2BaCTTc=)**

With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

* I’m a military veteran (**I joined at 17**),
* I’m a lawyer (**I utilized the GI bill to pay for law school**)
* I’m a former Trump Administration appointee, having held various jobs during the four years President Trump held office.

**The thing I’m most proud about? My family built our own American Dream without the help of the government, or left-wing socialist politicians. **I’d love to know where else in the world, immigrants from one of the Earth’s poorest nations could rise from homelessness and become successful business owners in a matter of two decades. All the while, raising their children with such success that one of them decides to seek federal office. **

Rising from poverty in Haiti to the middle class in South Florida wasn’t quick or easy, but _**what is worth having in life that is easy?**_ I learned from my parents that hard work and grit – along with perseverance – pays dividends. Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. name: Adam Schiff
subject: Teachers deserve more
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
| I was proud to lead my colleagues in the House and Senate along with Senator Cory Booker by introducing The Respect, Advancement, and Increasing Support for Educators (RAISE) Act of 2022.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=238%2E5257348%2EWifb4-)
Derek,
All across the United States, teachers put their hearts and souls into educating our kids and ensuring a brighter future for our country. Unfortunately, we haven’t treated their profession with the respect, or compensation, it deserves — and it’s led to a crisis for our nation’s future.
_That’s why it’s time to give teachers _a raise_._
Far too often, educators struggle to make ends meet. They pay for school supplies out of their own pockets, earn below the national living wage, with near-constant assaults on their right to collectively bargain and vilification in right-wing media.
The pandemic only exacerbated what was already a crisis. Educators earn 20 percent less than similarly-qualified professions, and the salary gap between teachers and those with similar education levels is greater than in any other developed country.
Early childhood educators earn a national median wage of just **$11.65 per hour**. As teachers retire, the next generation is less likely to replace them due to the burden of student loans and the lack of fair compensation to live a quality life.
That’s why this week, I was proud to lead my colleagues in the House and Senate along with Senator Cory Booker by introducing _The Respect, Advancement, and Increasing Support for Educators (RAISE) Act of 2022._
[**Add your name as an original citizen cosponsor of the _RAISE Act_ so we can finally pay teachers what they deserve.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/survey/engagement-20220506-raise-act?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220506_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=238%2E5257348%2EWifb4-)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/survey/engagement-20220506-raise-act?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220506_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=238%2E5257348%2EWifb4-)
---
Among other things, the _RAISE Act_ would provide refundable tax credits of up to $15,000 for educators, increase funding for the Elementary and Secondary Education Act’s Title II by $3 billion, and create and fund a federal grant program so local school boards and municipalities can draw from those funds to increase teacher salaries.
In short, a real raise for our teachers.
As Republicans wage a nationwide assault on the teaching profession, from banning books to threatening job termination with bills such as Florida’s “Don’t Say Gay” bill, it’s time for Congress to put our teachers first.
A quality education is the best investment in our nation’s future, and investing in teachers is how we can ensure our children have the best possible future as well.
[**So Derek, add your name as a citizen cosponsor of the _RAISE Act_ as I introduce it in the House. I would be grateful to have your support.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/survey/engagement-20220506-raise-act?refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220506_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=238%2E5257348%2EWifb4-)
