body:
| | | |
---
| | | Dear Peter, I recently attended an event at the Veteran’s Resource Center in Winnebago, Minnesota. What a fantastic venue to host this event. I arrived early and was honored to receive a tour of the facility, which has been created by passionate community members to provide a safe place for veterans in southern Minnesota.

This event was a strong reminder that we as a country need to continually recognize the sacrifices made by the men and women of the armed forces to help us protect democracy. More importantly, we need to honor the financial and healthcare commitments we made to these veterans.

As an attorney for 25 years, I’ve been honored to work shoulder-to-shoulder with veterans in pursuing VA benefits, providing volunteer legal services in clinics and pro-bono legal representation in family law or financial matters. Through these close contacts, I have a great appreciation for the emotional and financial challenges that returning veterans face, especially following deployment.

As your Congressman I will keep these issues front and center and make sure the financial commitments to our Veterans are honored. More importantly, I will fight hard to make sure that these benefits and programs reach ALL VETERANS in southern Minnesota, not just those in the metro or regional centers.

**_IMPORTANT ELECTION INFORMATION_** _: The First Congressional District Special Primary Election will be held on Tuesday, May 24. You can vote on Election Day at your regular polling location. You can also vote early at the office of your local elections official. Click_[ _HERE_](https://bendaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ace2cfdb811af9316dec053d7&id=305a99f37b&e=58a207e9d5) _to find your local elections official._
---
|
---
I was honored to tour the Space Force room at the Veteran’s Resource Center. I have a niece and nephew that were recently commissioned into the Space Force. To say “I am proud of their service” is a huge understatement. Our country is in good hands if we continue to have such patriotic heroes step forward to serve.

Peter,

As you know, I challenged a career politician in 2020 who has been in D.C. since 1986. I narrowly lost that race – **by just about 5 points** – after Nancy Pelosi spent more than $5 million on defense.

Now, Peter DeFazio is calling it quits and has endorsed the Oregon Labor Commissioner to replace him in D.C.

Over the last several months we’ve seen a groundswell of support from every corner of the country. From Republican leaders in Washington, D.C., to folks in Oregon’s 4th district, t**o the more than 9,000 conservatives who have made a contribution to help me flip this seat Republican** for the first time since 1975.

The Republican primary on May 17th is fast approaching, and it’s the goal of my campaign to build as much momentum as we can before then. I'm hoping to get 1,000 conservatives to personally endorse my campaign before May 17th (Primary Day). **Would you do me the honor of signaling your endorsement of my candidacy today?**

| | This week has clarified in my mind the need for equitable and just representation in politics. First, the leak from the Supreme Court demonstrated how some citizens of our great country are not protected enough; and the protections that do exist can be removed to serve the agenda of a minority. Then, Thursday I was honored to join the MMIWG March in Toppenish, where I witnessed firsthand the damage that is done when the voices of those who need representation are ignored. Women have been raising the call and fighting for their rights for far too long without the support and representation of those in power. When we protect the rights, dignity, and bodily autonomy of those who are vulnerable, we protect all of society. We can and must serve our communities better.
---
| Esta semana ha aclarado en mi mente la necesidad de una representación equitativa y justa en la política. Primero, las noticias de la Corte Suprema demostraron cómo algunos ciudadanos de nuestro gran país no están suficientemente protegidos; y las protecciones que existen pueden eliminarse para servir a la agenda de una minoría. Luego, el jueves tuve el honor de unirme a la Marcha del MMIWG en Toppenish, donde fui testigo de primera mano del daño que se produce cuando se ignoran las voces de quienes necesitan representación. Las mujeres han estado alzando la voz y luchando por sus derechos durante demasiado tiempo sin el apoyo y la representación de quienes están en el poder. Team, this couldn’t be more urgent.

A shocking and downright dangerous draft opinion shows that **the Supreme Court is planning to overturn _Roe v. Wade_** \-- undoing _50 years of precedent_ and opening the door for an onslaught of Republican-led bans on the right to have an abortion.

Republicans are only going to ramp up their attacks from here, **so now is the time to fight back to preserve the right to choose.**

**[Please, sign our official Democratic petition to DEMAND that the Supreme Court uphold _Roe v. Wade_ >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/7638?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20220506-Kati-RoeOverturnPT-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20220506-Kati-RoeOverturnPT-ETG-sl1&akid=4092%2E9716520%2E8rc86P)**

| | [Add My Name](https://go.dscc.org/go/7638?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20220506-Kati-RoeOverturnPT-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20220506-Kati-RoeOverturnPT-ETG-sl1&akid=4092%2E9716520%2E8rc86P)
---

Make no mistake -- without _Roe v. Wade_ , there will be nothing stopping Republicans from coming after abortion access, birth control, and all aspects of reproductive health care.

There are already reports that if Republicans win control of Congress in November, **they will make it their mission to pass a nationwide abortion ban.**

Saving the future of reproductive rights is only possible if we take action NOW, **which is why we’ve DOUBLED our signature goal on our petition to defend reproductive rights.**

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Who's to say they won't come after other fundamental rights?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
#
Peter,
_Roe v. Wade_ was a 7-2 decision. It’s been a hard precedent for five decades.
So when the news broke on Monday night that the Supreme Court was readying a 5-4 decision to ignore this precedent and end abortion rights as we know them in this country, it became clear to me: **SCOTUS justices lied under oath when they were testifying to Congress on this question.**
But don’t just take it from me. Here’s what Justice Neil Gorsuch had to say about _Roe v. Wade_ during his 2017 confirmation hearing:
> _“It is a precedent of the U.S. Supreme Court. It was reaffirmed in Casey in 1992 and in several other cases. So a good judge will consider it as precedent of the U.S. Supreme Court worthy as treatment of precedent like any other.”_
And here’s what Justice Brett Kavanaugh had to say about _Roe v. Wade_ during his 2018 confirmation hearing:
> _“It is settled as a precedent of the Supreme Court, entitled the respect under principles of stare decisis. The Supreme Court has recognized the right to abortion since the 1973 Roe v. Wade case. It has reaffirmed it many times.”_
Finally, here’s what Justice Samuel Alito — who drafted the presumed majority opinion on _Roe v. Wade_ that leaked Monday — had to say during his 2006 confirmation hearing:
> _“Roe v. Wade is an important precedent of the Supreme Court. It was decided in 1973, so it has been on the books for a long time. It is a precedent that has now been on the books for several decades.”_
If the Supreme Court strikes down _Roe v. Wade_ , who's to say they won't come after other fundamental rights, like gay marriage or interracial marriage next? **This draft decision completely undermines and delegitimizes the Supreme Court as a body that can make decisions that are not just purely political.**
Peter, yes, I’m angry. But here’s the thing: there is still time to act to protect abortion rights. The Senate must step up and codify _Roe v. Wade_ without delay. [**If you’re still with me in this fight for reproductive rights, chip in $3 now:**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13612?refcode=em20220506-1243&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1243%2E420207%2EBN-YeC)
**[Donate $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13612?refcode=em20220506-1243&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1243%2E420207%2EBN-YeC)**
I refuse to stand idly by while a group of far-right justices reverses 50 years of precedent.
It has been a tough week, but I refuse to give in to despair. I will keep fighting tooth-and-nail to codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law, and I’m more grateful than ever to have this movement on my side.
In solidarity,
Pramila

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**

subject: “I sign my checks to buy access.” -Rep. Trone on why he funds anti-choice extremists
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ben Smilowitz for Congress
body:
My primary opponent is a major donor of Texas Gov. Abbott | | | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

**[“I sign my checks to buy access.”](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=f9912216e0&e=0faa9de128) -Congressman David Trone**

This is a shockingly candid admission from our current representative in Congress and my primary opponent, Rep. Trone. His argument is that he funds campaigns where he has business interests (Trone continues to run his multi-billion dollar business while serving in Congress).

A whole lot of those checks went to extremist Republicans like Texas Governor Greg Abbott.

[Gov. Abbott alone received $45,000 from Rep. David Trone](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=5e73f9e641&e=0faa9de128), and Abbott’s anti-choice agenda is on the verge of becoming the law of the land. In fact, Mr. Trone was making large donations to Republicans [just months](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=61af4b42b8&e=0faa9de128) before news broke that he was planning to run for Congress.

As a candidate for Congress who is asking for your support, I want to be very clear – **Reproductive health decisions are private and should be made by women in consultation with their doctors. The government has no right to interfere.**

Rep. Trone has spent tens of millions of dollars to buy elections and influence legislation for HIS benefit – even if it meant helping anti-choice extremists like Texas Gov. Greg Abbott.

[_But if you believe Maryland can do better than a man who proudly puts his business interests before his own stated “values” and the interests of the people who sent him to Washington, please head to my website, learn more about this campaign, and donate._](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=4fe81e0543&e=0faa9de128)

I have SO much more to say on this, and I will soon. But right now, we need to get to work.

Thank you for everything. We are in this together.

Ben
[www.bensmilowitz.com](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=f0cb8bada7&e=0faa9de128)

subject: Weekly Update
body:
This election will be a referendum on abortion | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f404531fd7a1/weekly-update?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Peter, The 2022 Election was supposed to be a referendum on the Biden and Democrat economy, on their COVID-19 lockdown, mask and school policies, and a referendum on Biden's foreign policy that left a ravaged Afghanistan in the wake of a disastrous evacuation and failed to prevent a global war in eastern Europe. And sure, this election will certainly still be about those things.

But the [news this week coming out of the Supreme Court](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=da39d7852d&e=20ac8f046f), that Roe v. Wade may finally be overturned later this year, has set us on a new political course for this November. The [Democrats want to make Abortion the main issue](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=d4d595f8ae&e=20ac8f046f). They believe it's a winning issue. Of course, we know otherwise. We know that a Supreme Court ruling to overturn Roe v. Wade will give the power of legislating abortion back to the States...where it belongs. What do they have to fear if it's such a winning issue?

Answer: They have to fear those of us who want to protect the lives of all individuals, INCLUDING the unborn. They have to fear a people whose patience ends when their babies are treated as chattel. They have to fear Republican Congresswomen with the better argument.
---
|
---
| We need a Republican candidate who can talk confidently about the importance of protecting our unborn children. Someone who is willing to run on a platform that protects the [Right to Life](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=a13c016e47&e=20ac8f046f). A person who can sympathize with women on an issue Democrats use to exploit them for their vote.
---
|
---
| Courtney has worked with patients (as a nurse) and heard testimonies from Christians (as a fellow believer) who are traumatized by and regret the decision to not carry their child to term. Democrats want women to ["shout [their] abortions"](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=98667c18d0&e=20ac8f046f); Courtney recognizes that women and the unborn both have the Right to Life, and both are worthy of love and kindness.

If elected, Courtney Geels will be that Congresswoman who can make the better arguments and enact legislation that protects our children.

Early voting for the Primary is available through May 14. Election day is May 17. You can find more details on registration, the primary process, and important dates [HERE](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=92566cd16d&e=20ac8f046f).

---

---

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Proud to accept your nomination
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=djQfE775Qc1ig4yqRJJ%2Bpvk%2BRGzhyGDF&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
I just walked off the floor of the Connecticut Democratic Party convention, where I was proud to accept the party's nomination for re-election to the U.S. Senate. Democrats can't take a single seat for granted this year - if we do, we'll hand the Senate right back to Mitch McConnell. But the Senate GOP has already targeted me and has $44 million in the bank to flip this seat. [**So at this major moment for our campaign, I 'm asking directly: If you're with me in the fight to protect this Senate seat and maintain Democratic control of the Senate, will you pitch in a contribution right away?**](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1176-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
We've been through a lot of tough fights together, and we're in one of the most consequential as we speak: The battle to protect a woman's fundamental right to reproductive healthcare. We know that there will be more to come, but our job has always been to fight for the people, no matter how powerful the special interests that stand in our way.
In accepting tonight's nomination, I'm proud of just how much we've delivered for the people of Connecticut: Tax cuts for families struggling with rising costs, $14 billion to help small businesses grow and thrive, helping veterans get the benefits they deserve and modernizing our VA Hospital, and cleaning up the Long Island Sound and protecting our environment.
**Most critically, after decades of unkept promises, we delivered on infrastructure - bringing $4 billion to Connecticut to repair our roads, bridges, and broadband. This work makes us safer and stronger. **[**If you believe in the importance of Democratic Senate control to continue delivering on progress for our country, will you make a donation to protect this must-win Senate seat?**](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1176-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
I've dedicated my career to public service. I will always fight for the people I serve, and I will not back down.
I'll continue fighting my heart out to force Big Pharma to allow generic drugs into the marketplace. I'll call out Facebook and Big Tech to protect our children from internet predators. I'll stand up to Big Oil and make them pay a windfall profits tax for their price gouging. I'll keep fighting to suspend the federal gas tax.
But it doesn't end there. I will fight with everything I have to make our communities safer by passing common sense gun violence prevention measures. I'll work with law enforcement to make sure they have the resources to keep us safe with _better_ policing methods, to stop the flow of fentanyl and other drugs into our communities, and to _help_ those struggling with addiction and mental health problems.
Importantly, I need you to know this and take it to heart: I will keep standing up to Donald Trump and his GOP loyalists who are hellbent on undermining our democracy and weakening voting rights. And you better believe that I will continue fighting to pass the Women's Health Protection Act - because it is a fundamental human right to determine if and when to have a family.
To accomplish all of this, we must all take action and prevent the U.S. Senate from falling into the hands of Mitch McConnell and his band of Trump Republicans. The stakes are too high, and we've got too much work to do.**So I 'm asking you to help me carry forward the momentum from today. We've set a big goal to raise $10,000 before midnight. Can I count on your contribution?**
[**Rush $5 or more now - whatever you can spare to help us hit this goal - so we can defend Connecticut's Senate seat and protect Democratic Senate control!**](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1176-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
Thank you so much.
Dick

| | Friend,

As the highest-ranking Pro-Choice official from Louisiana, I cannot be silent when my constituents are being threatened with legislation that would criminalize bodily autonomy, personal freedom, and choice.

[__**This bill and this wider debate is not about life, it's about control. If it were truly about life, Louisiana would be investing in parental care, early childhood education, food assistance, universal pre-k, and other policies that improve outcomes for children.**__](https://troycarter4congress.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=730efe15a2&e=dd5c2df611)

Instead of investing in children after they are born, this bill would establish a pregnancy to prison pipeline, punishing Louisianans for exercising control over their own bodies.

This legislation is a terrifying example of a post-Roe future for my constituents. In Congress, I will do all I can to codify access to the full complement of reproductive healthcare and put an end to devastating policy proposals like this.

I [call](https://troycarter4congress.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47f144cfbca3f0c81de469f60&id=ac1ebb4490&e=dd5c2df611) on my friends and former colleagues in the state legislature to vote against this dangerous bill that would strip away personal liberties and freedoms from the people of Louisiana.

It’s been a busy month on the campaign trail with lots to recap! First, however, I must inform you that voting started TODAY. While I much prefer old fashioned Election Day to Election-Month-And-A-Half, current Virginia law allows for early voting up to 45 days before the traditional Election Day. [Please click here](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=6f4eb6abc7ec4ab1a7d8d7de27be3596&_e=ESOj7HKqtGnaS1perub7xwAPk_gnGIECqUPXJqA6yviqZQyQ2ElFQbARKMXGGxD-j0Yuga0oizqQM-8FIFVjo2nfuXXI-GfndXbeCaM0jt0vjQdWXRrwZFlq9n1TOny7TJPhDUzZH-T8p8AIAx1BakyFijkp0yWaD8rdXkN7jfFPOEYIuookTpTrk7E0aCVJuNSCUwFTjVyYZ-IpR_T-He_MQBUc1wa7-JYh8mP4u4NOiP9UjG_lroOMBO1b3wqa3v4U5ztZjmNeLODZjhV5rA%3D%3D) for all early voting locations and times you can cast your ballot and put your ✅ next to Yesli Vega! We must nominate someone who can defeat Abigail Spanberger and take our conservative values to Washington. In the bluest part of the district I have won and fought for dramatically lower taxes, to deport criminal illegal aliens, against unconstitutional gun control resolutions, more police officers, and to defund and abolish our misnamed “Office of Equity and Inclusion” pushing CRT and discrimination against White people. All in a district President Trump lost twice. If you want a conservative fighter who will take it straight to the Democrats in Washington, I’m your gal, and I ask for your support in this pivotal election. **Endorsement Update** Our coalition continues to grow as some of the leading movement conservative voices in Virginia and across the nation are getting behind my campaign for not only being the most principled conservative candidate in the race, but also the most likely to be able to turn out the voters necessary to send Abigail Spanberger packing in November. Conservative, America First fighters Ginni Thomas and Corey Stewart recently joined Ken Cuccinelli, Richard Viguerie, and Senator Ted Cruz in supporting our campaign. None of these five give their endorsements out lightly and I’m honored they recognize me as the candidate most likely to secure our border, fight for election integrity, and stand up for our constitutional principles in the face of unwavering attacks from the Democrats and the political Left. I was also honored to earn the endorsement of the Statewide “Women for Glenn” Chair, Rooz Dadabhoy, and former Seventh District Republican congressional candidate and current State Delegate, John McGuire. Delegate McGuire has been a stalwart conservative in Richmond, leading the fight against disastrous bills like [HB257](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=6f4eb6abc7ec4ab1a7d8d7de27be3596&_e=ESOj7HKqtGnaS1perub7x7FEJcchKO0KOaUPBuhXuHSYGbL22zXIIVX825kfOW1StBsG06nslmuwkgtbztzmDDh1y5n-WVELh0VpfaRFAjEsRj146Bl8S4EMWiDWbFxWXFDdh5yxcRlKPoilpPbAmblTbKab5Zd3KDvsI7Crks0pP3GzlOH3MuJDu-Y32iIvOl16Hvo99YZdtyz4gOVxosC8m5it85dTc_E_2dxAd2cTo9kzvlQe4w33z7wiZeqM1Jk7ViNMrjUBIEUQWx2wV6StL33Y3lUGTovjJE7WMG4Xq9zx0h0SKpl8JjKwsruiIZwRFmA1Ycb-7acwlKerP2CsloeISIK5mInwOXBEB5Y%3D) and the [“Bingo Tax”](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=6f4eb6abc7ec4ab1a7d8d7de27be3596&_e=ESOj7HKqtGnaS1perub7x8M497vab69q0IQSGYppUHqNkqp5MlrTJKKKwKhPPrRIFmOSipz9xoo7zUpPUAQakQg9hjctekc7C6t6v82y9A7i3p5DicKYwmjRKh41gCN-YPoJteRfnQk683wunxoB8IlCKCqUyDcy6FQ2PDNZz6IWHbQXwccbIrYmWnje6QXgHodUYU0Zdn00V1soGuiPYPcc_P1_NgFwCQ4Q5nxtL5MdomiqeEULNR-uIWsrPXHnaONzMOu7H9424bOQBtQdLKtPTHJtNPoaKHs788OOP5IWtweyRIUWzs8c1CE-OlJ5vRxkH-F6TKfAav0h05tHVINv9ElntWzoy6jk6xthOJixk6nnQa903CIUlH_QSo5B) on veteran and charity groups. Finally, in a sign of how Republicans from across the spectrum recognize our campaign as the most likely to win in November and defeat Spanberger, I was endorsed by former Virginia Congressman and successful two-time NRCC Chairman, Tom Davis. From his experience, Congressman Davis knows a successful campaign when he sees one and I’m excited he’s betting on us. **Fundraising Update** In another sign of the momentum and support for our campaign, we outraised our closest competitor by nearly $100,000 last quarter. Thank YOU – as this is truly about you. The average contribution we’ve received so far has been $42. Aside from Delegate McGuire, my campaign hasn’t been propelled by the big-wigs and lobbyists down in Richmond. It’s truly been a grassroots movement and that wide swath of support is what’s going to propel us to victory. Subsequently, we were added to the NRCC “Young Guns, On the Radar” list. With Spanberger sitting on over $4 million dollars in the bank, we’re not going to be able to defeat her with nothing. I’m so honored by the support you’ve entrusted into me [and hope you’ll continue to do](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=6f4eb6abc7ec4ab1a7d8d7de27be3596&_e=ESOj7HKqtGnaS1perub7x7o0AiDevthdA42UCECiAQb36C5fCx4pI0_ej3FPSfBiTUc4Tlwf8XmGefUc62A8ImL5lf3AfOxeQK0uJRT06DRw1qhCoz_jEEYoyxHosmnKK4EOTEsVxFVz9uxK9ZoyFfQP9zkx3M00DlGlw9UXEgiKEYMf6XRBab5e01_a4jZSFsYc35udd06WPKVmLcdLpN-MEN5b8fESWZVnah921HWDewOoarVlBHHdA7VwNdcL-DQegUMWZWKRRzAzszaAxfTkp9w9SBAlyt64zVoRStc%3D). **Events, Meet and Greets, & Forums** I’ve lost track of the miles I’ve put on my car crisscrossing the district from Prince William to Madison County, down to King George, Fredericksburg, and back. It’s been a delight to get to meet so many Patriots thus far at the candidate forums, meet and greets, and club meetings. You’re truly the tip of the spear and the grassroots rockstars that make our country go. I recently sat down with a legend of our conservative movement who told me, “Yesli, I fight on behalf of the conservative movement because it’s the greatest force for good within the Republican Party. The Republican Party is the greatest political force for good within the United States. And the United States is the greatest force for good in the world and the last beacon for all of Western Civilization.” That’s how important you all are. Please continue to stay engaged and I look forward to meeting you soon if I haven’t already! **Fredericksburg GOP Meeting** **King George GOP Meeting** **7th District GOP Convention** **Movimento Church of Culpeper** **Orange County Farm Tour and Meet & Greet** ** Stafford GOP Meeting** **Woodbridge Candidate Forum** **Montclair Candidate Forum** **Republican Advance ** **Vaisakhi Day Event** **Greene/Madison County Farm Tour & Meet & Greet** **Grace Church of Fredericksburg** **Prince William Latino Festival** **Campaign Kickoff Feat. Ken Cuccinelli & Corey Stewart ** Though four months into it, we had our formal campaign kickoff event April 23rd at the Ashland Conservancy in Prince William with my Campaign Chairman, Ken Cuccinelli, 2018 Republican Senate nominee, Corey Stewart, and Women for Glenn Chair, Rooz Dadahboy. And boy, was it a great turnout! Over 200 Patriots from throughout the district showed up on a beautiful Saturday that they could have been doing anything else to help us formally launch our campaign.
By comparison, Abigail Spanberger was also in Prince William that day and barely able to draw a dozen Democrat Party elected officials and liberal activists to a meet and greet on her behalf. These photos speak volumes. We must nominate someone who can energize the base and take it to Spanberger in the major population centers of the district, like Prince William. It’s clear where the energy and excitement lies, and that will be all the more apparent against Spanberger and the Democrats this fall. **Virginia March for Life ** On the morning of April 26th I got up bright and early and made my way down to Richmond for the Virginia March for Life. While we didn’t know that the Left would soon be leaking the news of the possible return of the issue of abortion back to the states and the people, where it belongs, the love and positivity on the ground from the pro-life generation was already palpable. In Congress, I will do all that I can to protect innocent life and the unborn. Of course Wonder Woman is pro-life!

**Virginia Family Foundation Visit & Women for Glenn Event** On Wednesday, I was honored to have lunch at the Family Foundation with their interns and other guests. The Family Foundation does tremendous work throughout the Commonwealth promoting life and traditional family values. It was such an encouragement to see our next generation have the courage to stand up for our values that have come under such assault. Later, I attended a Women for Glenn event hosted by Women for Vega Chair, Rooz Dadahboy. They were one of the most instrumental coalitions that put Governor Youngkin into office last year. Upset by prolonged COVID lockdowns and inappropriate material being taught to their children at school, these Mama Bears rose up and ended our twelve-year long drought. Amongst other distinguished guests, we were honored by the attendance of our wonderful and beautiful First Lady and Lieutenant Governor. **Media Blitz** I recently brought our unapologetic conservative message to several local and national media outlets including the Capitol Report, America’s Voice, The John Fredericks Radio Show, Joe Thomas, The Schilling Show, The Virginia Star, Newsmax, and a Spanish speaking outlet, The DC Express. **I’ll Do the Same in Washington** At the top of my e-mail, I listed just a few of the things I’ve fought for in the most challenging part of the district for Republicans, Prince William County. If you want to know what one will do in Washington you have to look at what they’ve done with the responsibility they’ve already been given. Every year I’ve been on the Board of Supervisors, I have proposed and fought for, at minimum, a reduced, equalized tax rate on our citizens and to kill any new tax proposals levied by money hungry Democrat politicians, including a Boat Tax and Meals Tax. Your money belongs to you. You know the best and most efficient way to spend it. More money in your pocket means more power and liberty for you as a sovereign individual and less for inefficient, bloated government. Last month, as part of our yearly budget, I proposed a significantly reduced residential tax rate which would have offset the artificial increase in home values and provided $327 of tax relief back to Prince William County, Virginia residents from what was eventually passed and over $700 from last year’s rate. I also proposed nearly $80 million in spending cuts to county government including the elimination of funding to set up a monopoly bargaining ordinance whereupon county employees can unionize and bargain against those they supposedly serve and to eliminate the divisive, and, frankly, racist and discriminatory “Office of Equity and Inclusion.” We’ve learned a lot about what the Left means by those terms over the last couple of years and it ain’t pretty. CRT and equity policies are not only racist but eliminate the ideal of a meritocracy that we all so value and strive for as Americans. As your next member of Congress, I will fight to lower tax bills on hardworking Virginia families so that the federal government is returned to its rightful, constitutionally mandated size. And I will fight back against the divisive attempts by the Left and modern day Democrat Party to divide and look at everything and everyone through the prism of race.
For Liberty,

Endorsement Update Our coalition continues to grow as some of the leading movement conservative voices in Virginia and across the nation are getting behind my campaign for not only being the most principled conservative candidate in the race, but also the most likely to be able to turn out the voters necessary to send Abigail Spanberger packing in November. Conservative, America First fighters Ginni Thomas and Corey Stewart recently joined Ken Cuccinelli, Richard Viguerie, and Senator Ted Cruz in supporting our campaign. None of these five give their endorsements out lightly and I’m honored they recognize me as the candidate most likely to secure our border, fight for election integrity, and stand up for our constitutional principles in the face of unwavering attacks from the Democrats and the political Left. I was also honored to earn the endorsement of the Statewide “Women for Glenn” Chair, Rooz Dadabhoy, and former Seventh District Republican congressional candidate and current State Delegate, John McGuire. Delegate McGuire has been a stalwart conservative in Richmond, leading the fight against disastrous bills like and the on veteran and charity groups. Finally, in a sign of how Republicans from across the spectrum recognize our campaign as the most likely to win in November and defeat Spanberger, I was endorsed by former Virginia Congressman and successful two-time NRCC Chairman, Tom Davis. From his experience, Congressman Davis knows a successful campaign when he sees one and I’m excited he’s betting on us. Fundraising Update In another sign of the momentum and support for our campaign, we outraised our closest competitor by nearly $100,000 last quarter. Thank YOU – as this is truly about you. The average contribution we’ve received so far has been $42. Aside from Delegate McGuire, my campaign hasn’t been propelled by the big-wigs and lobbyists down in Richmond. It’s truly been a grassroots movement and that wide swath of support is what’s going to propel us to victory. Subsequently, we were added to the NRCC “Young Guns, On the Radar” list. With Spanberger sitting on over $4 million dollars in the bank, we’re not going to be able to defeat her with nothing. I’m so honored by the support you’ve entrusted into me . Events, Meet and Greets, & Forums I’ve lost track of the miles I’ve put on my car crisscrossing the district from Prince William to Madison County, down to King George, Fredericksburg, and back. It’s been a delight to get to meet so many Patriots thus far at the candidate forums, meet and greets, and club meetings. You’re truly the tip of the spear and the grassroots rockstars that make our country go. I recently sat down with a legend of our conservative movement who told me, “Yesli, I fight on behalf of the conservative movement because it’s the greatest force for good within the Republican Party. The Republican Party is the greatest political force for good within the United States. And the United States is the greatest force for good in the world and the last beacon for all of Western Civilization.” That’s how important you all are. Please continue to stay engaged and I look forward to meeting you soon if I haven’t already! Fredericksburg GOP Meeting King George GOP Meeting 7th District GOP Convention Movimento Church of Culpeper Orange County Farm Tour and Meet & Greet Stafford GOP Meeting Woodbridge Candidate Forum Montclair Candidate Forum Republican Advance Vaisakhi Day Event Greene/Madison County Farm Tour & Meet & Greet Grace Church of Fredericksburg Prince William Latino Festival Campaign Kickoff Feat. Ken Cuccinelli & Corey Stewart Though four months into it, we had our formal campaign kickoff event April 23rd at the Ashland Conservancy in Prince William with my Campaign Chairman, Ken Cuccinelli, 2018 Republican Senate nominee, Corey Stewart, and Women for Glenn Chair, Rooz Dadahboy. And boy, was it a great turnout! Over 200 Patriots from throughout the district showed up on a beautiful Saturday that they could have been doing anything else to help us formally launch our campaign. By comparison, Abigail Spanberger was also in Prince William that day and barely able to draw a dozen Democrat Party elected officials and liberal activists to a meet and greet on her behalf. These photos speak volumes. We must nominate someone who can energize the base and take it to Spanberger in the major population centers of the district, like Prince William. It’s clear where the energy and excitement lies, and that will be all the more apparent against Spanberger and the Democrats this fall. Virginia March for Life On the morning of April 26th I got up bright and early and made my way down to Richmond for the Virginia March for Life. While we didn’t know that the Left would soon be leaking the news of the possible return of the issue of abortion back to the states and the people, where it belongs, the love and positivity on the ground from the pro-life generation was already palpable. In Congress, I will do all that I can to protect innocent life and the unborn. Of course Wonder Woman is pro-life! Virginia Family Foundation Visit & Women for Glenn Event On Wednesday, I was honored to have lunch at the Family Foundation with their interns and other guests. The Family Foundation does tremendous work throughout the Commonwealth promoting life and traditional family values. It was such an encouragement to see our next generation have the courage to stand up for our values that have come under such assault. Later, I attended a Women for Glenn event hosted by Women for Vega Chair, Rooz Dadahboy. They were one of the most instrumental coalitions that put Governor Youngkin into office last year. Upset by prolonged COVID lockdowns and inappropriate material being taught to their children at school, these Mama Bears rose up and ended our twelve-year long drought. Amongst other distinguished guests, we were honored by the attendance of our wonderful and beautiful First Lady and Lieutenant Governor. Media Blitz I recently brought our unapologetic conservative message to several local and national media outlets including the Capitol Report, America’s Voice, The John Fredericks Radio Show, Joe Thomas, The Schilling Show, The Virginia Star, Newsmax, and a Spanish speaking outlet, The DC Express. I’ll Do the Same in Washington At the top of my e-mail, I listed just a few of the things I’ve fought for in the most challenging part of the district for Republicans, Prince William County. If you want to know what one will do in Washington you have to look at what they’ve done with the responsibility they’ve already been given. Every year I’ve been on the Board of Supervisors, I have proposed and fought for, at minimum, a reduced, equalized tax rate on our citizens and to kill any new tax proposals levied by money hungry Democrat politicians, including a Boat Tax and Meals Tax. Your money belongs to you. You know the best and most efficient way to spend it. More money in your pocket means more power and liberty for you as a sovereign individual and less for inefficient, bloated government. Last month, as part of our yearly budget, I proposed a significantly reduced residential tax rate which would have offset the artificial increase in home values and provided $327 of tax relief back to Prince William County, Virginia residents from what was eventually passed and over $700 from last year’s rate. I also proposed nearly $80 million in spending cuts to county government including the elimination of funding to set up a monopoly bargaining ordinance whereupon county employees can unionize and bargain against those they supposedly serve and to eliminate the divisive, and, frankly, racist and discriminatory “Office of Equity and Inclusion.” We’ve learned a lot about what the Left means by those terms over the last couple of years and it ain’t pretty. CRT and equity policies are not only racist but eliminate the ideal of a meritocracy that we all so value and strive for as Americans. As your next member of Congress, I will fight to lower tax bills on hardworking Virginia families so that the federal government is returned to its rightful, constitutionally mandated size. And I will fight back against the divisive attempts by the Left and modern day Democrat Party to divide and look at everything and everyone through the prism of race. For Liberty, Yesli Vega Prince William County Sheriff’s Deputy Prince William County Supervisor Conservative Republican for Congress | | Military Wife. Mother. body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/burrilforcongress/burril-update-campaign-trail-20220506?e=80f8383115)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Burril For Congress Supporters,

Wow! We are in the final week of the 2022 Primary campaign. I have been on the trail since November 29th! _159 days as of this writing. _
---
|
---
| The message of Conservative, Christian, Business leadership has been well received throughout this 15 county district. Even before Madison Cawthorn returned to run in this district again, it was obvious that the people of Western North Carolina wanted a change. His return to this district made this a nationally observed race. Here are some fundamentals:

**1. The amount of money thrown at negative advertising is astounding.** The Political Action Committees have purchased over $700,000 in broadcast, cable and mailer advertisements. That's crazy! This is a Primary election...we aren't even running against a Democrat yet!

**2\. Voters are seeking authenticity.** This is a wide lane. Because I have spent so much time in the district meeting people face to face, I have witnessed hundreds of conversations about how disappointed people are in our current Congressman. They feel violated that they gave him their personal endorsement and he has made a mockery of their good name. I spent 36 years managing people's savings with confidentiality and trust. I fully understand the value of a good name. It takes years to create and only a moment to destroy. An authentic person in this business is hard to find.

**3\. The people of WNC are incredible**. I have been so impressed with your integrity, honesty, loyalty, determination and kindness. It has been quite humbling to meet folks that have lived their entire lives helping others. Every day I get to meet another person who has made a difference in someone else's life. This has been incredibly encouraging. You are a faith based people. You do believe in doing good... especially to others.

**4\. I am confident that I am the correct person to represent you in Congress.** I have learned that representation is just that... representing the people. Your voices, your values, and certainly your good decision making. You have made excellent long term decisions regarding your families, your lifestyles, your work and who you choose to associate yourselves with. These are things I hold dear to my daily life. I have felt so comfortable bouncing around these mountains meeting you. Yes, you have made me feel welcome, but you have also made me feel like I am welcome to return to visit in the future.
---
| I am glad that the campaign is coming to a close. I am really glad that I have no regret in the long hours I have put in to get out and meet you. I have many new friends who will be specifically important to my role as your Congressman. You know what is needed in your neck of the woods and I am delighted to have an opportunity to go get the resources you need to make our lives better.

I am ready to win this seat and ask that you talk to as many people as you can to help get us across the line. So far turnout has been light. This election could be determined by as few as 100 votes, so EVERY vote will count. Light turnout is statistically good for Team Burril, so getting your family and friends to mark the ballot for me will make a difference.
---
|
---
| Lastly, please pray for the following:
* Election integrity
* Continued Momentum
* May 17th Poll Workers
* Our Supreme Court Justices

All my best,
---
|
---
Matthew Burril
Luke 1:37
Candidate for U.S. Congress

body:
The simple truth is that the people attacking me know I pose a threat to the Democrat Party’s hold over Black voters. |
---

Peter,

**I'm sad to be writing to you - _yet again_ - about racist attacks against our campaign for U.S. Senate. **

First, a liberal commentator began his barrage of attacks against me by writing in _The Nation_ :

| _**"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."**_
---

Then he went on MSNBC to say:

_**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens" - referring to Senator Tim Scott (R-SC) and me - "who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**_
---

Now, _The Washington Post_ has published new attacks from other detractors:

_**"Walker has positioned himself into being a useful fool for those who don't have the best interests of Black people or this democracy at heart."**_
---

and

_**"[Herschel Walker's] irrelevant to the Black community, and we should treat him as such."**_
---

**[The fact of the matter is this: the racist attacks are not going to stop anytime soon.](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=4057ac65d7c1499c9565e14f52d7f214&_e=ScHROEA4X6aDQuzqt7ewcfuyi6MBBXq21kfTKBozfUK_YDbKjAGvWlwTpTmGvmHMvAUHE3cUyD4GB_ngexdrEGKFYcgXCh7XZ8Ysgt067VFOxDpMDSmpO8og2EIVZMAvmJsA8CrhyHmtrYdN6yMVxKYnCvLJ93jtp9dwBzxkvLK0sH7Nj2xJlTFL6sRc1WlSQ_lXJ-ol_pF1OtIFBwD9HiYgiBnGYUMt7wf2jwyVxBKoCZaY0CJk1jX-8aXCNxVwfP6HmndgsVZy9CbFdRIdxSvEYcWFHjmYkj3iB5L5FhNBzcdVux2Yehjj9rMnhfFd0qNCLU9cZdJCyQtgvECs9jK9_Vmnjp_MRO1i-0o-jJw5CNH88b4zST52mZ05LLiMBOuf_t9S7T_joTfPShK2LNnyQOVCVDDxqWDYTZMdb99ibjVSdJVGDG-QHO3GW6SANquV01Dk4S1eQJZweBiVW9OLLobuTR2wlAu7WhoToV6NgNDlz1kADoSWz-poScck)** We need your help to fight back against them. We need to show the voters in Georgia how low some folks are willing to go to defame me and poison my image ahead of November's election.

If you reject the LIE that Black and Brown Americans are required to be Democrats, as some mistakenly believe, **[would you chip in $4, $10 or maybe even $25 right now to help our campaign set the record straight?](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=4057ac65d7c1499c9565e14f52d7f214&_e=ScHROEA4X6aDQuzqt7ewcfuyi6MBBXq21kfTKBozfUK_YDbKjAGvWlwTpTmGvmHMvAUHE3cUyD4GB_ngexdrEGKFYcgXCh7XZ8Ysgt067VFOxDpMDSmpO8og2EIVZMAvmJsA8CrhyHmtrYdN6yMVxKYnCvLJ93jtp9dwBzxkvLK0sH7Nj2xJlTFL6sRc1WlSQ_lXJ-ol_pF1OtIFBwD9HiYgiBnGYUMt7wf2jwyVxBKoCZaY0CJk1jX-8aXCNxVwfP6HmndgsVZy9CbFdRIdxSvEYcWFHjmYkj3iB5L5FhOYYn5yLdrrWrIOdHmp6JUHx-flWfSfzCwix05byJwJ21ko87_xlHLJJ722F6LVnAgbpstGSmuc8z5b_Wi5BD3-kUD5RqktE4ND8L0w1Tb-bgXMxaRtIaUy4gv8PoO4iIPO6-K9F7I35RdPXAP3C4P2dBsx-DOsSaGAoIChiDyuNXIaWrya6QmQtNYFb_Kp7AsPVdEanDgYnZv7ZrqwKWra)**

President Biden believes this lie. You'll recall that he told a Black radio host in 2020 that, "If you have a problem figuring out whether you're for me or Trump, then you ain't Black."

**I categorically reject that mindset. It's garbage.**

_**Nobody tells me what to think or how to vote. I study the issues and make up my own mind informed by my faith and values.**_

The simple truth is that the people making these racist attacks against me believe I pose a threat to the Democrat Party's hold over Black voters. They're attacking because they're scared.

, Gun violence is an out-of-control epidemic in South Carolina. ** ** The statistics speak for themselves: since 2010, gun deaths have increased by 42% in South Carolina, guns are the leading cause of death among children and teens in our state, and between 2015 and 2019, 120 South Carolina women were fatally shot by an intimate partner. ** ** Disappointingly, McMaster has failed to do anything to curb the gun violence epidemic in our state. He refuses to prioritize and pass common-sense gun reforms that would save lives by requiring background checks before sales of guns, keeping guns out of the hands of those adjudicated incompetent, and requiring liability insurance for gun owners. During my career in the state legislature, I've introduced and co-sponsored bills to do all these things. ** ** McMaster is so afraid to stand up to the NRA that he advocates for dangerous policies like open carry which makes it almost impossible for law enforcement to distinguish between the good guys and the bad. He fought the city of Columbia's prohibition on ghost guns. And adding to this gun craze, our state is moving forward with execution by firing squad. (no, this is not a joke) ** ** South Carolinians need an advocate who will stand up for common-sense gun legislation and protect our most vulnerable - that fighter is me. ** ** Thank you for standing with me, Mia
---
About Senator Mia McLeod: Senator Mia McLeod is a working mom, small business owner, and seventh-generation South Carolinian from Bennettsville, South Carolina. She is a former State Representative, current State Senator representing District 22, and is running as a Democratic candidate for Governor.

_**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Fellow American,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_

body:
Manga Anantatmula has been attacking me for the past two weeks in an attempt to steal the primary election to fuel her dangerous ego. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c12c7dd222e5/2022-rpv-advance-16092220?e=9ee2863374)

| |
---
| |
# _MANGA EXPOSED_
---
| Friends,

I wish I didn't have to write this email, but I've had enough.

A GOP candidate in the 11th District who claims to be an America First Patriot has been working with left-wing news outlets to slander my name.

**_Manga Anantatmula_ has been attacking me for the past two weeks in an attempt to steal the primary election to fuel her dangerous ego. **

The first **_LIE_** was a phantom text message sent to all delegates claiming I said I raised 200k for the election. This was a **_LIE_** and something I have never said during the course of this campaign.

Many delegates were outraged by this blatant misuse of the delegate list.

The next **_LIE_** was the widespread sharing of a[ ](https://chappellforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2bbb67d628f97b4388ee28de&id=a22b0d6890&e=9ee2863374)[**liberal hit piece**](https://chappellforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2bbb67d628f97b4388ee28de&id=edafc8c8e2&e=9ee2863374)[ from the Atlanta Journal-Constitution](https://chappellforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2bbb67d628f97b4388ee28de&id=3ca8b33244&e=9ee2863374).

Manga's team took it further and shared absurdly false information claiming I was under criminal investigation since I launched my campaign in February.

My legal team sent out a cease and desist letter to the Anantatmula camp in response to this false allegation.

This has not deterred her, as her team immediately sent out a ghost text following her receipt of the cease and desist letter. The ghost text sought to share the defamatory article with a larger audience in hopes of stealing the election 48 hours before Election Day.

Many delegates once again reached out with outrage. Several have stated they are afraid of the damage her campaign is causing to our party ahead of the midterms.

**This shortsighted anger has allowed her campaign to lose sight of the real opponent: Gerry Connolly. **

The voters demanded to know who the secret RINO in the party is. Now they do.

The voters of the 11th District are intelligent and informed. Her record of lies and failure speaks for itself.

She raised an abysmal amount of money in 15 months of campaigning, including personal loans; she lost to Gerry Connolly by 43.1% in the last election and is in no way a "trailblazing record-breaker," as she claims.

_**Her splashes in the kiddie pool rocked no boat. Gerry Connolly never even acknowledged her as a competitor. **_

Those are facts.

_**Her unstable ego has been on full display for voters over the past month. Look no further than the unhinged outburst at the Clifton Candidate Forum, where she sought to disrupt other candidates from speaking. **_

The 11th District does not need an egotistical liar representing them. The 11th District does not need someone who needs their team texting their answers to questions during forums. The 11th District deserves a proven fighter and a proven winner.

Vote for me on May 7th, and we will MAKE THE 11th DISTRICT GREAT AGAIN. We will stop the steal. We will retire Gerry Connolly.
---
|
---
| | |
# How can you support our campaign?

1\. Show up and vote for our grassroots campaign on May 7. We can't take back the 11th District without your support.

Details for the May 7 Party Canvass (Commonly referred to as a Firehouse Primary), can be found
[**BY CLICKING HERE**](https://chappellforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2bbb67d628f97b4388ee28de&id=a9dddb4db5&e=9ee2863374)

2\. DONATE - We can't do this without your support. If you can chip in **[$25, $50, $75, or $100](https://chappellforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2bbb67d628f97b4388ee28de&id=787980c664&e=9ee2863374)** to our cause.
---
|
Thank you again for all the support we've received to date. I look forward to working with all of you to defeat Gerry Connolly in November!

Onward,

Matthew Chappell

It’s Bernie Sanders.

Right now, super PACs and powerful special interest groups are spending a huge amount of money to defeat strong, progressive women of color running for Congress all across the country — including over $1 million on ads to defeat Nida Allam in North Carolina's 4th district.

Nida just bravely filmed a powerful TV ad about her experience having a life-saving abortion to end an ectopic pregnancy, but she needs to raise $14,892 by midnight to get it on air. With Roe v. Wade on the line, we need leaders like Nida in Congress now more than ever.

subject: I need your help to stop the racist attacks
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
The simple truth is that the people attacking me know I pose a threat to the Democrat Party’s hold over Black voters. |
---

Peter,

**I'm sad to be writing to you - _yet again_ - about racist attacks against our campaign for U.S. Senate. **

First, a liberal commentator began his barrage of attacks against me by writing in _The Nation_ :

| _**"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."**_
---

Then he went on MSNBC to say:

_**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens" - referring to Senator Tim Scott (R-SC) and me - "who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**_
---

Now, _The Washington Post_ has published new attacks from other detractors:

_**"Walker has positioned himself into being a useful fool for those who don't have the best interests of Black people or this democracy at heart."**_
---

and

_**"[Herschel Walker's] irrelevant to the Black community, and we should treat him as such."**_

### May 6, 2022
Friend -- May is off to a great start at the Republican Party of Wisconsin. We have been hosting several events designed to engage communities across Wisconsin and reach voters from all walks of life. Additionally, we are just two weeks away from our 2022 State Convention in Middleton! There is still time to register on our convention website [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=uuUyPGiVHWR_V3cUbcvCWRj2cMYkWVNJAvLz3dukgRI03s73cUlMp_-JMdenwImXcHmlm-nVIxFEoI4O3fslo-1WSz75GgaYgoPU4QX3CQWL2c-S7f4yo-9hgM15FKeh8wr_0BkIiHsfIq8nTdSeQg&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_6_22_v1&n=2). As always, thanks for all you do! \- Team WisGOP | To commemorate the week of Cinco de Mayo, the WisGOP joined the RNC to host a food drive at our Hispanic Community Center. Senator Ron Johnson even stopped by to give remarks and thank volunteers for their efforts. Hundreds of items were donated to support God Touch Milwaukee and families within Milwaukee’s Hispanic community who are struggling to find basic necessities due to skyrocketing inflation and supply chain crises under Joe Biden. Thank you to everyone who contributed! On Thursday, Kenosha County Republicans hosted a roundtable discussion moderated by KUSD School Board member Eric Meadows featuring commentary from parents, teachers, and local elected officials. Participants discussed timely topics like education transparency and parental rights. Read more in the Kenosha News [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=zN5gEYXLykR0kv-yDZpGDd8aT88UjLrn7NIcv-uCglZ-QcbEdCbu86caAosy5IxBvwC8j4IuKwKkDVFAfUnuTnaM8QZ9X1Dxz5oJ4ncegd3dGFyQU0svL50yLhmo_kA0iTIgiR_wSojEO6glFsYkmedXoBEp_AXCBabbhUqlN3iuZizmZmjG0QYDuZCUl8UwzeC7L8KY0mBvQmnu60KfSAoTej1bQAXrcOuAmQev4aIw27cq_bHUqWUiwuewJQf4J46XAMqj64osk_7doj5Hhg&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_6_22_v1&n=3).

| | We are approaching the registration deadline for the 2022 WisGOP Convention in Middleton on May 20-22! You can register online until May 18, 2022. Get your tickets on our convention website [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=uuUyPGiVHWR_V3cUbcvCWRj2cMYkWVNJAvLz3dukgRI03s73cUlMp_-JMdenwImXcHmlm-nVIxFEoI4O3fslo-1WSz75GgaYgoPU4QX3CQWL2c-S7f4yo-9hgM15FKeh8wr_0BkIiHsfIq8nTdSeQg&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_6_22_v1&n=4). We hope to see you there! As we await the official ruling from the Supreme Court, the WisGOP stands for the right to life and the right of the people to protect it. We applaud any Court decision that affirms the right to life and will proudly support candidates who do as well. Meanwhile, Democrat politicians have rejected what science tells us and have embraced radical abortion policies that are completely detached from the American mainstream. Democrats have [**refused**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TiV2ExMvy-B9xlTsmD5RGJqhla2mJT2kUxXWM9eS6hTHyV7lB8QjoZR-asQOUz0sgw&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_6_22_v1&n=5) to back any limits on abortion, including up to the moment of birth and after. Democrats even blocked legislation banning [**infanticide**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=AhFr39Kxe0zyYMvwPfgp0jhDYLj6ZA4mgD2sQqlHCDHnLQiUTEItLQFnHt9lGMChOwYVfEevXV0AseQTerS3F6jPGYH1kIuNYABT3UtVIF4q4taC3w-d1Xt-Cy1XM7Z1bn2c_sbDVYN6G03dRPdEwa-A1xpG1wV0AqD_OzfbZhE&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_6_22_v1&n=6). Life is precious and worth defending. Democrats are fighting to force their radical abortion agenda on all Americans – Republicans are fighting to stop them. Read the MacIver Institute’s piece on the top disinformation surrounding the potential decision [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=a9lVzACUQtvW78T1Y1IgXSTAWhYy73r-ZfSkFnsT9THaXdpNmycLm0qs3Yj-dh-32ylob7GYQ7QJHf0zHy1ysBIqV7M3bivwzD61hG9xmMP0fPes3xg7uYkJFqSsVDxKs9hUDruKnMy1ZsKt-QRiJAc9Ns852KVwqrztl_bAcyVbD7CdFKiObs2Mg6W_kE3C&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_5_6_22_v1&n=7).
